This ad is for position #3

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead



Job Overview



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Social Media, Creative & Performance Marketing Lead.



This is NOT a basic social-media posting job.



We already have staff who can handle routine posting, basic engagement and responding to simple comments.



We need someone at a much higher level.

:

Who should see it?



What should the ad look like?

What offer should we test?



Which audience should receive it?



How much should we spend?



Did it produce sales?



What do we change next?



You will be responsible for turning our products into compelling digital campaigns across social media, paid social, video,
 and SMS.



Our immediate priorities include:



Custom dye-sublimated shirts

Yard signs

Printing products

Seasonal promotions

Business customers

Repeat customers



Our ultimate objective is not followers or likes.



It is attention ? interest ? leads ? customers ? repeat customers ? revenue.

Develop the overall marketing strategy for:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

YouTube Shorts

Pinterest

LinkedIn where appropriate

Additional channels where there is a legitimate business opportunity



Determine:



What we should post

When it should be posted

Which content belongs on which platform

What should be organic

What should receive paid promotion

What should become an advertisement

What content should be reused/adapted

What trends are worth participating in

What does not fit our brand



Our VAs can help execute repetitive posting.



You own the strategy.

You must understand that modern advertising performance depends heavily on creative.



You will personally create or direct production of:



Static ads

Platform-specific creative

Shirts

? show shirt testimonials.

title: Lead Generation & Sales Closer — Countertop & Stone Business
description:
I’m looking for a hungry, competitive, sales-driven Virtual Assistant to help grow my countertop and stone business.



This is not a basic VA or administrative position. Your #1 responsibility is simple:



Generate qualified leads and turn them into paying customers.



If you’re good at prospecting, following up, talking to homeowners, booking estimates, and closing sales, there is significant earning potential beyond your hourly pay.



Compensation



* $4–$5 USD/hour

* 20 hours per week to start

* 5% commission on collected revenue from qualified jobs you personally generate and help close

* Performance-based opportunity for additional hours and responsibility



Commission Examples



Close a $5,000 project ? $250 commission



Close a $10,000 project ? $500 commission



Close a $20,000 project ? $1,000 commission



Commission is earned on eligible sales after the customer has committed and the required payment/deposit has been collected.



The goal is to reward actual revenue—not just calls, messages, or leads.



Your Main Responsibilities



* Generate your own countertop, stone, kitchen, and bathroom leads

* Prospect homeowners, contractors, realtors, property managers, designers, and other potential referral partners

* Find opportunities through social media, local groups, online platforms, directories, and outbound prospecting

* Respond quickly to incoming leads

* Call, text,
, and message prospects

* Qualify potential customers

* Book estimates and appointments

* Follow up aggressively and professionally with leads who haven’t made a decision

* Help overcome objections and move customers toward closing

* Re-engage old leads

* Keep every lead and follow-up organized in our CRM/tracking system

* Help build and manage our social media presence

* Track leads generated, conversations, appointments, estimates, sales, and collected revenue



I’m Looking for a Salesperson, Not Just a VA



You should be:



* Excellent at spoken and written English

* Confident on the phone

* Comfortable with cold outreach

* Persistent with follow-ups

* Comfortable asking for the sale

* Competitive and motivated by commission

* Organized enough to manage a sales pipeline

* Able to work independently without being constantly reminded what to do

* Willing to learn countertops, quartz, granite, stone fabrication, installation, kitchens, and bathrooms



Experience selling home improvement, construction, remodeling, roofing, flooring, countertops, real estate, solar, or other high-ticket services is strongly preferred.



Growth Opportunity



We’ll start at 20 hours per week.



I care about results.



If you can consistently generate qualified opportunities, book estimates, close profitable projects, and build an organized sales pipeline, I’m open to increasing your hours, responsibilities, and earning potential.



I want someone who eventually becomes an important part of growing the company—not someone who needs to be micromanaged every day.



To Apply



Answer all of the following:



1. Tell me about your sales and lead-generation experience.

2. What’s the most expensive product or service you’ve helped sell?

3. Have you done cold calling or outbound prospecting?

4. How would you generate countertop leads if I gave you no leads on your first day?

5. How many outbound calls/messages are you comfortable making in a workday?

6. Tell me about a difficult prospect you successfully converted.

7. How do you organize and follow up with dozens of leads?

8. A homeowner requested a countertop quote and then stopped responding. Write exactly what you would send them to restart the conversation.

9. Why do you think you can make money in a commission-heavy position?



Start your application with “5% CLOSER” so I know you read the entire posting.

* Follow up on estimates that haven’t closed

* Re-engage old leads

* Handle basic objections

* Ask for the business and help close deals

* Maintain relationships with commercial prospects who may not be ready immediately



Organization



* Keep every lead organized in our CRM or lead tracker

* Track calls, messages, follow-ups, appointments, estimates, and closed sales

* Maintain an organized sales pipeline

* Make sure leads don’t get forgotten

* Help manage and grow our social media presence



Commercial Cleaning Is a Priority



A major goal of this position is generating recurring commercial cleaning contracts.



I want someone who is comfortable identifying businesses, finding the person responsible for hiring cleaning services, contacting them, following up, and getting us an opportunity to provide a quote.



One good commercial account can become a long-term customer, so quality matters just as much as quantity.



Who I’m Looking For



You should be:



* Excellent at spoken and written English

* Confident making outbound calls

* Comfortable talking to business owners and decision-makers

* Experienced in lead generation, appointment setting, or sales

* Persistent with follow-ups

* Comfortable asking for the sale

* Organized

* Self-motivated

* Competitive and motivated by commission

* Able to work independently without constant supervision



Experience selling commercial cleaning, janitorial services, home services, property services, B2B services, or other local services is a major plus.



Growth Opportunity



We’ll start at approximately 20 hours per week.



I’m looking for results—not someone who simply logs hours.



If you can consistently generate qualified leads, book walkthroughs/estimates, close recurring accounts, and keep the sales pipeline organized, there will be opportunities for more hours, more responsibility, and increased earning potential.



To Apply



Please answer:



1. What lead-generation and sales experience do you have?

2. Have you done B2B cold calling before?

3. Have you sold cleaning, janitorial, home, or local services?

4. How would you find commercial cleaning customers if you started with zero leads?

5. What types of businesses would you target first?

6. How would you find the decision-maker at a company?

7. How many outbound calls/messages are you comfortable making per day?

8. Tell me about a lead you generated and successfully converted.

9. How do you organize follow-ups so prospects don’t get forgotten?

10. Write the exact message you would send to a business owner or property manager to introduce our commercial cleaning services.



Start your application with “CLEANING CLOSER” so I know you read the entire posting.

title: Creative Strategist/Copywriter/Creative Writer for Ecom Ads
description:
We are looking for a sharp and experienced Creative Strategist & Copywriter who knows how to engineer winning e-com ads. We are an aggressively scaling e-commerce brand looking for a sharp, independent, and action-oriented Creative Strategist to join our tight-knit team.



Compensation

$1000/month for 30 video ad concepts and 10 static ad concepts per month. Bonuses up to $600 per concept for winner ads. Potential up to $
/month



The Role

As our Creative Strategist and Copywriter, you will independently own the creative research and scriptwriting process for our ad campaigns. You’ll be breaking down customer desires, be up-to-date on market trends, and building high-converting visual and text-based ad blueprints.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Conducting deep-dive market research to find hidden customer pain points, desires, and angles.

• Writing high-converting, psychological ad scripts and concepts for both video and static ads.

• Utilizing AI tools to make your research and scriptwriting process faster

• Designing clear frameworks (hooks, transitions, CTAs) that our production team can easily execute.



Requirements

• Proven track record of ideating and writing high-performing ads

• Independent problem-solver who doesn't need constant supervision

• Deeply understands ad algorithms, metrics, and what makes creative content convert

• To confirm you’ve read everything, start your application with “I write killer ads.”

• Comfortable using AI tools

• Serious interest in a long-term, full-time role

• B1 or better English level



How to Apply

To apply, please answer these questions directly:



• What is the maximum amount of ad spend achieved on a single ad that you personally ideated and wrote in the past?

• What does your step-by-step market research process look like when building angles for a product? Where do you usually go to get data?

• What does your scriptwriting process look like? In your opinion, what are the most critical elements to making an e-com ad convert?

• What is your IQ score?

• Please share a link to a portfolio or examples of ad scripts/frameworks you have personally written.

• Optional: Sending a quick video of you speaking and going through all of this will make you a top consideration.



We are looking to hire fast. If you are ready to start ASAP, we want to hear from you!

title: Technical SEO / Google Indexing Specialist
description:
# Technical SEO / Google Indexing Specialist



I run an established local service website in New Zealand that already ranks in Google, receives good organic traffic and generates real customers.



I have one specific problem that I need help solving.



A significant number of genuine pages on the website are sitting in Google Search Console as:



* **Discovered – currently not indexed**

* **Crawled – currently not indexed**



Many other pages on the same website are indexed and ranking normally.



We've already investigated some of the affected pages. Google can access them, crawling and indexing are allowed, they're included in the sitemap, canonical URLs are correct and Google can successfully render them.



**I want to understand why Google isn't indexing more of these pages and what we can realistically do about it.**



## What I'm NOT looking for



I'm not looking for:



* More blog posts — I already have plenty.

* A generic automated SEO audit.

* A backlink package.

* Someone to rewrite all my meta descriptions.

* Someone promising #1 Google rankings.

* Someone who simply tells me I need "better SEO."



And initially, **you will not be making changes to the website.**



I want someone who can investigate first.



## Paid trial – US$60



I will select a small number of applicants for a **US$60 paid technical trial**.



The trial will involve up to approximately **3 hours investigating the indexing problem**.



I will provide more detailed information and relevant Google Search Console data to the selected applicants.



I want you to tell me:



1. What you think is happening.

2. What evidence supports your conclusion.

3. What is fact and what is still only a theory.

4. What you would test first.

5. How we would measure whether that test worked.



You do **not** need to pretend you know the answer before investigating it.



If you don't know something, tell me.



I'd much rather work with someone who says **“I don't know yet, but here's how I'll find out”** than somebody who confidently gives me an answer they can't support.



## What I'm looking for



You should have genuine hands-on experience with:



* Google Search Console

* Google crawling and indexing

* Technical SEO

* WordPress / WooCommerce

* Sitemaps and site structure

* Diagnosing indexing problems



I'm much more interested in **what you can actually do** than certificates or qualifications.



### When applying, please answer this question:

Please answer that question in your own words.



I don't need a long list of SEO services you provide.



## Longer-term opportunity



This trial is also about finding the right person for possible **ongoing permanent part-time work**.



If you're technically capable, reliable, honest about what you do and don't know, and we work well together, I'd like to have someone who can learn the website over time and help me with its technical SEO.



The ongoing hours and rate would be discussed separately if we d
 to work together.



I'm not looking for someone to blindly run my website.



I'm looking for someone who can **investigate, explain, test and measure.

title: Social & Community Manager (Part-Time, 2 Days/Week) - US Audience
description:
IMPORTANT: this is not a VA or admin job. If that's the work you're after, please skip this one.



We're a European startup. Our habit app is built on behavioural science and it launches in the US this December. Right now our US accounts don't exist at all: no TikTok, no Instagram, no X, no Shorts, no newsletter. You'd be the one starting them.



WHAT YOU'D DO

- Turn approved ideas into finished posts: carousels, quote cards, short-form video edits, story graphics

- Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok and Shorts

- Handle the community: replies, DMs, comments, polls, question boxes

- Run the newsletter: welcome and weekly sends, the list, the open rates

- Tell us each week what worked. That d
 what we make next



WHAT YOU NEED

- Either 2+ years in social media or content production, or a page of your own that you grew past 10,000 followers

- That audience should have been in the US. We don't mind where you live, we mind who was watching

- You can edit short-form video yourself (CapCut or anything similar)

- You can make clean graphics from an existing design system (Canva or similar)

- Genuinely fluent English, written and spoken, because you'll be writing publicly in our voice



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED

Animation or motion design on video. We may never ask for it. It's a real plus if you have it.



HOW IT WORKS

Our Head of Creative owns the strategy and the brand voice. You work out how it lands on each platform. It's mostly execution at the start, and your say grows as you get to know the audience.



WHAT WE COVER

- Every tool and subscription you need

- Bank transfer, and the transfer fees are ours

- Remote, and you arrange your own hours

- The occasional call with a UK-based colleague



WHEN YOU APPLY, SEND

1. A link to an account you grew, the follower count when you started and when you stopped, and where that audience was

2. One short-form video you edited yourself

3. Your CV or portfolio



If there's no video link we won't review it. We get a lot of applications.

title: One-Time Recruiter VA
description:
One-Time Recruiter VA — $160 Project



I’m looking for an experienced Recruiting / Hiring Virtual Assistant to help me find and screen a strong Lead Generation & Sales VA for my business.



This is a one-time recruiting project, not a permanent position.



Compensation





* Up to 20 hours total

* Maximum project budget: $160

* This project ends once the recruiting assignment is completed.



Your Job



I already know the type of salesperson I need. I need you to handle the time-consuming part of finding and screening candidates.



You will:



* Review applications and resumes

* Identify candidates with real sales and lead-generation experience

* Conduct short screening interviews

* Evaluate spoken English and communication skills

* Look for candidates who are confident on the phone

* Verify experience with cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, follow-up, and closing

* Ask candidates sales-based interview questions

* Eliminate weak or unqualified applicants

* Organize and score the strongest candidates

* Deliver 3–5 highly qualified finalists for me to personally interview

* Provide notes explaining the strengths and weaknesses of each finalist

* Recommend who you believe are the strongest candidates



Who I Need You to Find



The person you’re recruiting should be able to:



* Generate their own leads

* Cold call and conduct outbound outreach

* Follow up consistently

* Qualify potential customers

* Book appointments and estimates

* Help close sales

* Maintain an organized lead pipeline/CRM

* Speak excellent English

* Work independently

* Be highly motivated by commissions and performance



Experience recruiting salespeople, appointment setters, cold callers, closers, or lead-generation VAs is strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



At the end of this project, I don’t want 50 random applicants.



I want 3–5 strong candidates who have already been screened and are worth my time interviewing.



Your job is to do the first round of recruiting so I only have to speak with the best candidates.



To Apply



Please answer:



1. How much recruiting experience do you have?

2. Have you recruited salespeople or lead-generation VAs before?

3. How would you determine whether someone is actually good at sales instead of just saying they’re good?

4. What would you ask during your screening interview?

5. How would you narrow a large applicant pool down to the best 3–5 candidates?

6. Can you complete the project within the 20-hour / $80 maximum budget?



Start your application with “TOP RECRUITER” so I know you read the entire posting.

title: Outbound Cold Caller/ Appointment Setter - Life Insurance
description:
We are looking for a confident and experienced Outbound Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact U.S. leads and consistently book appointments for a licensed life insurance agent.



MAIN GOAL



Your job is simple:



CALL LEADS ? CREATE INTEREST ? BOOK APPOINTMENTS



We provide the leads. You do NOT need to find or purchase leads.



Many of the people you contact already have life insurance. Your goal is to create interest in speaking with our licensed agent about their current coverage and whether other available options may be a better fit for them.



The licensed agent's primary appointment availability is:



Monday–Thursday | 2:00 PM – 8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time 



Your main objective is to consistently fill these available appointment slots with qualified prospects.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Make outbound calls to leads we provide.

Speak confidently and professionally with U.S. consumers.

Generate interest in having their existing life insurance coverage reviewed and compared with available options.

Handle basic objections and keep the conversation moving toward an appointment.

Schedule interested prospects directly onto the agent's calendar.

Focus on filling appointment availability between 2:00 PM and 8:00 PM Eastern Time.

Keep accurate notes on each lead and appointment.

Follow all provided calling, opt-out, and Do Not Call procedures.

IMPORTANT



You are an appointment setter — NOT an insurance salesperson.



You will NOT sell insurance, recommend specific policies, quote premiums, take applications, advise someone to cancel or replace their existing policy, or provide insurance advice.



Your responsibility ends after generating interest and scheduling the prospect with the licensed agent.



The licensed agent handles the actual insurance consultation, recommendations, and sale.



WHO WE WANT



We are looking for someone who:



Has previous outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

Has excellent spoken English.

Is comfortable calling U.S. consumers.

Sounds confident, friendly, and natural on the phone.

Is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

Can handle rejection and basic objections.

Can follow a script without sounding robotic.

Is motivated by performance and wants to book appointments.

Has reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet working environment.

Is dependable and communicates well.



Previous U.S. cold-calling experience is strongly preferred.



Life insurance experience is a PLUS, but it is NOT required. 



COMPENSATION



$6 USD/hour guaranteed base pay.



Additional performance-based bonuses may be awarded for consistently generating high-quality appointments that show up and produce strong results.



Strong performers will have opportunities to earn additional compensation and potentially receive additional hours.



PERFORMANCE WE TRACK



We will track:



Number of outbound calls

Number of conversations

Appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Quality of appointments



HOW TO APPLY



Please include ALL of the following:



Your previous cold-calling/appointment-setting experience.

Industries you have previously called for.

Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day.

Your normal working availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

A short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your cold-calling experience.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



We provide the leads, calling guidelines, script, and appointment calendar.



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term member of our team if the initial trial goes well.

title: Studio Growth & Enrollment Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**



We are a growing dance studio with a strong reputation in our community. We believe dance is about far more than movement. We build confidence, leadership, friendships, and lifelong skills through the art of dance. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help share that mission and welcome new families into what we are building.





**What This Role Is**



This is a remote, part time position and it is heavily sales focused. The core of this role is outbound outreach to warm leads who have already expressed interest in the studio. These are real people who opted in. Your job is to connect with them, build genuine rapport, and move them toward enrollment through real conversations.



This role is built for someone who can own it. We will give you the structure, the tools, and the direction. After that, we expect you to run with it. The goal is for the right person to own this role fully with little to no hand holding from management. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



This role will evolve. The core is outreach and enrollment, but the scope will grow and shift based on what the studio needs. Some days that means following up with leads. Other days it might mean hunting for new ones, supporting a campaign, creating content, or finding creative ways to generate interest in the community. Whatever drives growth is fair game, and the right candidate will embrace that rather than push back on it.





**What You Will Do**



- Call new leads as fast as possible the moment they come in. The first studio to make contact almost always wins.

- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured outreach system

- Manage leads through a full follow up cadence and know where every lead stands at all times

- Log all activity and report daily on outreach and lead responses

- Hunt for new leads through social media, community groups, and online platforms

- Support seasonal campaigns, content creation, and community outreach as needed

- Take on additional tasks as the role grows and studio needs shift





**What We Are Looking For**



- English level C1 or higher, spoken and written. We will assess this.

- Exceptionally strong phone presence. This is the number one filter for this role. You need to sound calm, confident, and in control on every call. Prospects can feel hesitation and uncertainty immediately, and it kills trust before the conversation even starts. If you are smooth, natural, and able to guide a conversation without fumbling, you will thrive here. If phone calls make you nervous or unsure, this is not the right fit.

- Experienced in sales, lead follow up, or relationship based outreach

- Highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently without daily oversight

- Motivated by results and energized by conversations

- Experience with CRM tools or lead tracking systems is a plus

- A background or genuine interest in dance is a bonus, not a requirement





**Schedule**



- Part time, 20 hours per week spread across 7 days

- Availability required during Pacific Standard Time business hours

- Payment is made bi weekly via Wise





**Why This Role Matters**



Every family that reaches out is looking for something real for their child or for themselves. Your job is to make sure they find it here. The faster you respond, the more genuine your follow up, and the better you understand what they need, the more lives this studio gets to impact. This is not a job where you clock in and clock out. It is a role where the right person makes a real difference.



**To Apply**



Send your resume and a short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit. Tell us about a time you followed up consistently with someone and it made a real difference.



Put **Blue Elephant** in the subject line or message title. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Position: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Overview

We are a growing Canadian construction and service company looking for someone who wants more than a traditional accounting role.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of our finance and administrative operations. This person will play a key role in helping leadership make informed decisions, maintain healthy cash flow, and ensure the business runs smoothly behind the scenes.



The ideal candidate is a self-motivated leader who anticipates business needs before they arise. We value a professional who communicates with clarity, maintains flawless organization, and demonstrates a relentless commitment to following through on every initiative.



Key Responsibilities

- Full cycle bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online

- Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable

- Weekly cash flow forecasting and reporting

- Bank reconciliations and payment scheduling

- Monitor company cash position and flag potential cash flow issues early

- Follow up on outstanding customer payments

- Payroll support and payroll reconciliations

- Budget tracking and financial analysis

- Assist with month end and year end preparation

- Work closely with our Canadian CPA

- Maintain financial records and support compliance requirements

- Assist with HR administration and employee records

- Improve internal processes, documentation, and financial controls

- Keep leadership informed of important deadlines, risks, and priorities

- Help create reports that support business growth and decision making



Who are we looking for

- CPA preferred

- Has experience supporting Canadian companies

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Strong understanding of cash flow management

- Superior proficiency in written and verbal English

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Honest, dependable, and accountable

- Able to manage confidential financial information with integrity

- Comfortable working independently while keeping leadership informed

- Positive attitude and willingness to continuously improve systems



What Success Looks Like



Within the first six months, you will:



- Keep financial records accurate and up to date.

- Ensure payments and payroll are processed on time.

- Maintain reliable cash flow forecasts that support decision making.

- Proactively identify financial risks before they become problems.

- Improve at least two internal processes that increase efficiency or accuracy.

title: Meta Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
Meta Lead Conversion Specialist



**Location:** Remote

**Employment:** Full-Time

**Department:** Sales / Customer Experience

**Platform:** Sprout Social / Meta

**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Customer Experience Manager



## ABOUT TAYLOR CONTRACTORS



Taylor Contractors is a rapidly growing New Zealand trade services company operating across multiple regions throughout the country.



Our brands provide plumbing, drainage, gasfitting, leak detection, electrical and infrastructure services to residential and commercial customers.



Our social media network currently generates significant customer attention across
 and Instagram, including more than **220,000 content views and 1,500+ link clicks** during the current reporting period.



We are looking for a highly motivated **Meta Lead Conversion Specialist** whose responsibility is simple:



**Turn social media conversations into qualified customers.**



This is NOT a social media content creation role.



This is a customer engagement and sales role.



You will work inside **Sprout Social**, monitoring incoming messages, comments, enquiries and relevant customer interactions across our Meta network.



Your job is to engage quickly, understand what the customer needs, gather the required information and move qualified customers into our booking and sales process.



---



# THE ROLE



You will actively monitor:



*
 Messenger

* Instagram Direct Messages

*
 comments

* Instagram comments

* Meta advertising enquiries

* Responses to advertisements

* Relevant customer interactions

* Existing conversations requiring follow-up



Every genuine customer enquiry represents a potential job.



We expect enquiries to be handled quickly, professionally and commercially.



You should not simply answer questions.



You should **progress conversations toward an outcome.**



---



# PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



The objective is:



**ENGAGEMENT**



?



**CONVERSATION**



?



**QUALIFICATION**



?



**CUSTOMER DETAILS**



?



**FORM COMPLETED / LEAD CREATED**



?



**TAYLOR CONTRACTORS CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE / SALES**



?



**JOB BOOKED**



Your success will ultimately be measured by the number and quality of customers you move into our sales pipeline.



---



# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. Respond to Meta Enquiries



Monitor Sprout Social throughout your shift.



Respond promptly to genuine customer:



* Messages

* Comments

* Questions

* Advertising enquiries

* Service enquiries



Customers should receive fast responses during operating hours.



---



## 2. Convert Conversations Into Leads



Do not allow genuine enquiries to become endless conversations.



Determine what the customer needs and move them toward the next step.



Example:



Customer:



"My drain keeps backing up. Do you guys come to Lower Hutt?"



Response:



"Yep, absolutely — we cover Lower Hutt. Is the drain completely blocked at the moment or still draining slowly?"



Customer:



"Completely blocked."



Response:



"No problem, we can help with that. I'll get this through to the team as urgent. Can you please send through your address and best contact number?"



?



**Qualified Lead**



?



Immediately escalate to Customer Experience.



---



# 3. CUSTOMER INFORMATION



Where appropriate, obtain:



* Name

* Phone number

*

* Property address

* Region

* Service required

* Description of issue

* Urgency

* Photos

* Videos



Where Taylor Contractors uses an enquiry form, direct the customer to complete the form and follow up to ensure it has been completed.



Do not simply send a link and forget about the customer.



---



# 4. CONVERSATIONAL SELLING



We want natural conversations.



Communication should sound:



* Friendly

* Confident

* Helpful

* Direct

* Human

* Professional

* New Zealand appropriate



Avoid robotic corporate responses.



### Good:



"Yep, we can definitely help with that. Would you have a couple of photos you could send through? I'll get the team to have a look and we can work out the next step for you."



### Good:



"That's something we deal with regularly. If you send through your address and contact number I'll get this through to the team."



### Good:



"If sewage is currently overflowing, I'll mark this as urgent and get someone onto it now. What's the best number to reach you on?"



### Avoid:



"Thank you for contacting our esteemed organisation. We greatly appreciate your enquiry."



Communication must feel like a real member of a New Zealand company is helping the customer.



---



# 5. FOLLOW-UP



Many customers will not respond immediately.



Qualified prospects must be followed up appropriately.



Example:



"Hey James, just checking whether you still needed a hand with that blocked drain? Happy to get the team onto it for you."



The objective is persistent professional follow-up without annoying or misleading customers.



Every active conversation should have:



**A response, a next action, or a final outcome.**



---



# 6. URGENT LEADS



Immediately escalate enquiries involving:



* Burst pipes

* Sewage overflow

* Completely blocked drains

* Major active leaks

* Flooding

* No water

* Emergency plumbing

* Urgent commercial failures

* Customers wanting immediate attendance



Do NOT spend 20 minutes messaging an emergency customer.



Get their:



**Name + Phone + Address + Problem**



and immediately hand the opportunity to the New Zealand team.



---



# 7. HIGH-VALUE LEADS



Immediately flag potential:



* Drain replacements

* Sewer repairs

* Water main replacements

* Major leak repairs

* Hot water cylinder replacements

* Commercial work

* Property management opportunities

* Hydro jetting

* CCTV and drainage investigations

* Larger plumbing projects

* Repeat commercial maintenance



These opportunities should be handed to Customer Experience / Sales quickly.



---



# 8. LEAD HANDOVER



A lead should not simply be described as:



"Customer needs plumber."



The handover should contain:



**Customer:** James Smith

**Location:** Lower Hutt

**Phone:** 021 XXX XXXX

**Service:** Blocked Drain

**Issue:** Main sewer appears completely blocked

**Urgency:** Urgent

**Photos:** Received

**Source:**

**Status:** Customer ready for call



The New Zealand team should be able to immediately pick up the lead and close it.



---



# 9. SPROUT SOCIAL MANAGEMENT



You are responsible for maintaining a clean and organised social inbox.



This includes:



* Responding to genuine enquiries.

* Clearing completed conversations.

* Tagging conversations correctly.

* Assigning conversations where required.

* Flagging urgent enquiries.

* Maintaining customer notes.

* Ensuring unanswered enquiries do not disappear.

* Following up active prospects.

* Keeping the inbox organised.



---



# STRICT KPIs



This is a performance-based role.



Performance will be measured weekly and monthly.



## RESPONSE TIME



**Target:** Under 5 minutes during rostered operating hours.



**Minimum Standard:** 90% of genuine enquiries responded to within 10 minutes.



---



## INBOX COVERAGE



**Target:** 100%



Every genuine service enquiry must be:



* Responded to

* Qualified

* Escalated

* Followed up



or



* Correctly closed as irrelevant / lost



No genuine enquiry should remain forgotten in the inbox.



---



## QUALIFICATION RATE



**Initial Target:** 60%+ of genuine service enquiries progressed to a qualified lead where the customer is serviceable and has genuine intent.



This KPI will be reviewed once sufficient Taylor Contractors baseline data has been collected.



---



## LEAD HANDOVER QUALITY



**Target:** 95%+



Qualified leads handed to the New Zealand team should contain the required customer and job information.



---



## FOLLOW-UP COMPLIANCE



**Target:** 100%



Every active sales conversation requiring follow-up must receive the required follow-up.



---



## FORM COMPLETION



Where customers are directed to an enquiry form:



The salesperson remains responsible for progressing the conversation until:



* Form completed

* Customer declines

* Customer becomes unresponsive after the approved follow-up sequence

* Lead is handed directly to Customer Experience



Sending the form link alone does NOT count as a conversion.



---



## SALES PIPELINE CONTRIBUTION



Primary monthly performance metrics will include:



* Qualified leads generated

* Qualified lead rate

* Form completions

* Jobs handed to Customer Experience

* Booked jobs originating from Meta

* Revenue originating from Meta leads

* Average response time

* Follow-up completion

* Lost lead reasons



**Revenue and booked jobs matter more than message volume.**



---



# IMPORTANT KPI PRINCIPLE



We will NOT judge performance based purely on:



* Number of messages sent

* Likes

* Comments

* Followers

* Views



Those are marketing metrics.



This is a **sales role**.



The ultimate measurement is:



**How much genuine customer opportunity did you create from our Meta audience?**



---



# WHAT YOU WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



* Creating social media content

* Designing graphics

* Editing videos

* Running Meta Ads

* Google Ads

* SEO

* Website development

* Technical plumbing advice

* Creating your own pricing

* Dispatching technicians

* Technician management

* Accounts



Your responsibility is:



**ENGAGE ? QUALIFY ? CONVERT ? HANDOVER ? FOLLOW UP**



---



# IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English.

* Can communicate naturally with New Zealand customers.

* Is confident selling through chat.

* Is persistent without being aggressive.

* Responds extremely quickly.

* Understands customer intent.

* Can recognise buying signals.

* Is comfortable asking customers for their details.

* Can manage multiple conversations simultaneously.

* Is highly organised.

* Is commercially minded.

* Takes ownership of outcomes.

* Enjoys targets and measurable performance.

* Can work independently.



Previous experience in:



* Chat sales

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation

* Customer service

* Meta Messenger sales

* Social selling

* Trade services

* Home services



would be highly regarded.



---



# PERFORMANCE REVIEW



Performance will be reviewed weekly during the initial employment period.



We will review:



**Enquiries**



?



**Conversations**



?



**Qualified Leads**



?



**Form Completions**



?



**Booked Jobs**



?



**Revenue**



The objective is continuous improvement in conversion throughout the funnel.



---



# CAREER OPPORTUNITY



As Taylor Contractors grows, this role has the opportunity to progress into:



**Meta Lead Conversion Specialist**



?



**Senior Lead Conversion Specialist**



?



**Digital Sales Team Leader**



?



**Digital Sales Manager**



We intend to build a larger digital sales function as our advertising reach and regional operations expand.



---



# TAYLOR CONTRACTORS



**Remote Position**



If you are competitive, organised, confident communicating with customers and enjoy converting conversations into sales opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Admin and personal assistant for lawn care and landscaping company
description:
Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant



Position: Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant

Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time

Work Location: Remote

Reports To: Owner/Management

Company: C&J Lawn Care and Landscaping / Winchester Hardscapes



Position Overview



C&J Lawn Care and Landscaping and Winchester Hardscapes are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant to assist with the day-to-day administrative responsibilities of our growing landscaping, lawn care, and hardscape businesses.



The primary purpose of this position is to take routine administrative and coordination tasks off the owner’s plate, allowing management to focus on sales, estimating, project management, crews, customer relationships, and growing the companies.



This individual will help manage incoming communication, scheduling, customer follow-up, material ordering, job coordination, paperwork, and general office organization.



The ideal candidate is someone who does not need to be told every small task that needs to be completed. We are looking for someone who can recognize what needs attention, prioritize tasks, follow through, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Primary Responsibilities



Customer Communication



* Answer incoming business phone calls professionally.

* Respond to customer
s and routine inquiries.

* Return missed calls and voi
s.

* Gather information from prospective customers regarding requested services.

* Enter customer information and notes into the company’s CRM.

* Direct technical, pricing, complaint, or project-specific questions to the appropriate person.

* Provide customers with basic scheduling and project updates when authorized.

* Maintain professional and timely communication with existing and prospective customers.



Appointment & Calendar Management



* Schedule estimates, property assessments, consultations, and other appointments.

* Coordinate appointments based on management’s availability and geographic location.

* Confirm upcoming appointments with customers.

* Reschedule appointments when weather, project delays, or other circumstances require changes.

* Maintain an organized calendar and help prevent scheduling conflicts.

* Prepare a daily or next-day schedule so management knows exactly where they need to be and when.



Lead Management & Follow-Up



* Monitor incoming leads from phone calls,
, website inquiries, CRM, social media, and other lead sources.

* Contact new leads promptly.

* Gather the necessary information before scheduling an estimate.

* Follow up with customers who have received estimates but have not responded.

* Track pending estimates and proposals.

* Follow up on approved projects that need deposits, selections, scheduling, or additional information.

* Maintain an organized list of outstanding customer decisions and follow-ups.



Material Ordering & Vendor Coordination



* Order approved materials for upcoming projects.

* Contact suppliers to confirm pricing, quantities, availability, and lead times.

* Coordinate material delivery or pickup dates with the project schedule.

* Confirm orders before scheduled installation dates.

* Maintain records of material orders and order confirmations.

* Notify management immediately of shortages, backorders, price changes, or delivery problems.

* Help coordinate hardscape materials, landscape materials, plants, mulch, stone, gravel, topsoil, and other commonly used materials.



All major purchases and non-routine purchases must receive management approval before being placed.



Job & Project Coordination



* Review upcoming jobs to make sure required materials, customer selections, deposits, and documentation are complete.

* Maintain an organized list of upcoming and active projects.

* Communicate scheduling updates to customers.

* Help coordinate between management, customers, suppliers, and crews.

* Track outstanding items that could delay a project.

* Make sure customer-approved changes are documented before additional work is performed.

* Assist with preparing and organizing change orders when project scopes change.



CRM & Administrative Management



* Keep customer information accurate and up to date.

* Enter notes from customer conversations.

* Upload photos, documents, proposals, and other information to the appropriate customer/job file.

* Maintain organized digital records.

* Create and update customer tasks and reminders.

* Help ensure completed jobs move through the proper administrative process.

* Monitor overdue administrative tasks and bring them to management’s attention.



Estimates, Contracts & Documentation



The assistant may help prepare documents using company templates and information supplied by management, including:



* Estimates and proposals

* Scope-of-work documents

* Change orders

* Customer contracts

* Maintenance agreements

* Scheduling notices

* Deposit requests

* Project completion communications



The assistant will not independently determine project pricing or make contractual commitments without authorization.



Accounts Receivable & Customer Payments



* Monitor outstanding invoices.

* Send routine payment reminders.

* Follow up professionally on past-due balances.

* Maintain a list of overdue accounts requiring management attention.

* Confirm receipt of deposits when necessary.

* Assist with sending invoices and payment links.

* Escalate serious collection issues to management.



Daily Owner Support



One of the most important responsibilities of this position is helping management stay organized.



The assistant should maintain a running list of:



* Calls that require the owner’s attention

* Estimates awaiting decisions

* Customers needing follow-up

* Materials that need approval or ordering

* Upcoming appointments

* Jobs requiring scheduling decisions

* Outstanding customer selections

* Change orders requiring approval

* Past-due invoices

* Supplier or subcontractor issues

* Important deadlines



Rather than sending numerous interruptions throughout the day, non-urgent items should be consolidated whenever possible.



Daily Workflow



The assistant should begin each workday by reviewing:



1. New
s and messages

2. Missed calls and voi
s

3. New customer leads

4. Today’s appointments

5. Tomorrow’s appointments

6. Active jobs requiring attention

7. Material orders and deliveries

8. Outstanding estimates and follow-ups

9. Past-due invoices

10. Tasks requiring management approval



At the end of the day, the assistant should provide management with a concise summary containing:



Completed Today



* Important tasks completed



Needs Your Attention



* Decisions or approvals needed from management



Tomorrow



* Appointments, deliveries, deadlines, and important follow-ups



Decision-Making Authority



The assistant is encouraged to independently handle routine administrative matters within established company procedures.



Management approval is required for:



* Pricing changes

* Discounts

* Refunds

* Major purchases

* Contract modifications

* Project scope changes

* Promises regarding project completion dates

* Customer disputes

* Employee disciplinary matters

* Legal matters

* Any unusual situation involving significant financial responsibility



The goal is for the assistant to solve routine problems independently while escalating decisions that genuinely require ownership or management involvement.



Qualifications



The ideal candidate will have:



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong organizational abilities

* Professional phone etiquette

* Ability to manage multiple priorities

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills

* Comfortable working with customers

* Experience with scheduling and calendar management

* Experience using CRM or business management software

* Basic understanding of invoicing and accounts receivable

* Ability to learn landscaping, lawn care, construction, and hardscape terminology

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding company and customer information



Experience working with a landscaping, construction, home-service, contracting, or trades business is strongly preferred.



Software & Technology



Experience with the following is preferred:



* Jobber or similar CRM software

* QuickBooks Online

* Google Workspace

*
 and calendar management

* Microsoft Office

* Cloud-based file storage

* Vendor websites and online ordering systems



Characteristics We Are Looking For



We are specifically looking for someone who is:



Proactive – Looks ahead instead of waiting to be told what to do.



Organized – Keeps appointments, customers, projects, and paperwork from falling through the cracks.



Dependable – Does what they say they will do and follows through.



Professional – Represents the company well when communicating with customers and vendors.



Detail-Oriented – Understands that small mistakes in scheduling, materials, or customer communication can create large problems.



Resourceful – Attempts to find solutions before immediately asking management.



Accountable – Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Calm Under Pressure – Can manage changing schedules, customer concerns, weather delays, and the fast pace of a service/construction business.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this position means management spends significantly less time dealing with routine administrative work.



Within the first several months, the assistant should be able to independently manage most routine:



* Phone calls

*
s

* Appointment scheduling

* Customer follow-ups

* Lead tracking

* Estimate follow-ups

* Material ordering

* Vendor communication

* Invoice reminders

* CRM updates

* Project paperwork

* Calendar organization

* Customer scheduling communication



The ultimate goal is simple:



If a task does not require the owner’s expertise, physical presence, pricing authority, or final decision, the assistant should eventually be capable of handling or coordinating it.

title: Senior Ecommerce Graphic Designer / Performance Creative lead
description:
We're looking for a high-level graphic designer + marketer who understands how to create static advertisements that actually sell.



This is not a Canva/template design position.



We work in the supplement and health ecommerce space, and we need someone who understands the customer, the market, the avatar, the mechanism and the advertising strategy before opening Photoshop/Figma.



You need to be able to look at a product and think:



Who is this for, what do they believe, what are they struggling with, what have they already tried, and what visual would make them stop scrolling?



Supplement Experience Is REQUIRED



You must have previous experience creating advertising creatives for:



Supplements

Health products

Wellness

Functional health

Vitamins

Skincare / beauty with a health angle



If you've never worked with supplement or health brands, this probably isn't the right position.



Please tell us exactly which brands you've worked with and what you created for them.



You MUST Understand Avatars



We need someone who understands what an avatar actually is.



Not:



"Women aged 40–60."



That's demographics.



We want someone who understands the person behind the demographic.



Their:



Problems

Desires

Fears

Frustrations

Beliefs

Previous solutions

Objections

Awareness level

Language

Buying motivations

In your application:



Explain what an avatar means to you and give us an example of how you would research one before creating an advertisement.



Tell Us How You Research



This is extremely important.



Before creating a static ad, how do you figure out what the market actually cares about?



Tell us your actual research process.



For example:



Customer reviews

Reddit

Amazon

Competitor advertisements

Meta Ad Library

Forums

Product reviews

Scientific research

Search data

Customer comments

Existing advertorials

Competitor funnels



We want to understand how you arrive at a creative idea, not just how you execute somebody else's idea.



Long-Form Native Statics



You must understand long-form static advertising.



We're not only looking for:



Product + headline + button



We want someone capable of creating native-looking, information-heavy static advertisements that can communicate a story or argument visually.



For example:



Long-form advertorial-style statics

Educational advertisements

Mechanism-based advertisements

Problem/solution creatives

"News/article" style creatives

Doctor/expert-style educational creatives

Customer story creatives

Comparison creatives

Infographic-style advertisements

Native-looking editorial creatives



You need to understand how to make a lot of information visually digestible without making the creative look like garbage.



You Understand Direct Response



You don't need to be a copywriter.



But you must understand direct-response advertising.



You should understand concepts such as:



Awareness levels

Market sophistication

Customer objections

Mechanisms

Angles

Hooks

Benefits vs features

Social proof

Curiosity

Pattern interruption

Problem agitation

Belief building

Offer communication



Most importantly, you should understand that different angles require different visual executions.



We Want A Marketer, Not Just A Designer



If we give you:



Product + Avatar + Angle + Mechanism



you should be able to take that information and develop the visual concept yourself.



We don't want to explain every pixel.



We want someone who can say:



"I understand the customer. Here's how I would communicate this idea visually."



And then execute it at a very high level.



Your Portfolio



Don't send us a massive portfolio of random graphic design work.



Show us your best-performing ecommerce advertisements.



Especially:



Supplement / health creatives.



For each relevant example, tell us:



Product

Target avatar

Angle

Creative concept

Your role

Platform

Results, if available



If you have winning creatives, show us the winners.



APPLICATION — YOU MUST ANSWER THESE

1. What supplement/health brands have you worked with?



Give us the brand names and explain what you personally created.



2. What does "avatar" mean to you?



Explain it in your own words.



3. How do you research an avatar before creating an advertisement?



Give us your actual process.



4. How do you research new creative angles?



Where do you look?



5. What is a long-form native static ad?



Explain how you would approach designing one.



6. Show us 3 long-form/native static advertisements you've created.



Preferably for health or supplements.



7. Pick one of your advertisements that performed very well.



Why do you think it worked?



8. How would you visually approach the same supplement for three different avatars?



Give us an example.



9. How do you d
 whether an advertisement should look:

Native/editorial

Premium/branded

Educational

UGC-inspired

Direct-response

Clinical/expert

Problem-focused



Explain your thinking.



10. What tools do you use?



Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, AI tools, etc.



The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who is:



Designer + Marketer + Creative Strategist



You should have:



? Strong professional graphic design skills

? Supplement/health ecommerce experience

? Strong understanding of avatars

? Strong research skills

? Direct-response knowledge

? Experience creating static Meta ads

? Experience with long-form/native statics

? Ability to develop concepts independently

? Ability to understand mechanisms and angles

? Strong visual storytelling

? Understanding of ecommerce funnels



NOT WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



? Canva template designers

? Social media graphic designers

? Logo/branding-only designers

? Generalist designers with no ecommerce experience

? People who have never worked with supplements

? Designers who need every concept handed to them

? People who only make aesthetically pleasing creatives without understanding conversion



If you cannot answer the questions above, please don't apply.



We're looking for someone who can think commercially, understand the customer and then turn that understanding into high-level creative.

title: Healthcare Staffing & Registry Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and fast-paced Healthcare Staffing & Registry Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will be the vital link between our client healthcare facilities and our pool of registry clinicians (RTs, RNs, LVNs, CNAs, and Allied Health professionals). You will manage daily scheduling requests, ensure 100% credentialing compliance, and handle real-time staffing adjustments to ensure seamless patient care.



Key Responsibilities

- Scheduling & Coordination: Coordinate and schedule registry clinicians (RNs, LVNs, CNAs, Allied Health) to effectively meet daily and contract facility staffing requests.

- Communication Hub: Serve as the primary point of contact to communicate shift details, confirmations, cancellations, and real-time updates clearly with both clinicians and facility managers.

- Compliance & Credentialing: Maintain highly accurate clinician profiles, credentials, and compliance documentation. Proactively monitor expirations for professional licenses, certifications, and medical requirements.

- Logistics & Problem Solving: Manage last-minute staffing needs, unexpected call-offs, and immediate replacements in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.

- Quality Assurance: Ensure all clinician assignments strictly meet facility-specific requirements and state/federal regulatory standards.

- Data Management: Accurately document all scheduling activity, shift adjustments, and communication logs within the workforce management system.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with recruitment, compliance, and operations teams to streamline onboarding and maximize staff readiness.

- Clinician Retention: Build strong, trust-based relationships with our healthcare professionals through consistent, supportive communication and prompt issue resolution.



Job Requirements

- Experience: 1–3 years of proven experience specifically in healthcare staffing, registry coordination, or healthcare scheduling.

- Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of medical terminology, nursing credentials (RN, LVN, CNA), and healthcare compliance standards.

- Tech-Savvy: Experience working with scheduling software, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), or workforce management systems.

- Soft Skills: Outstanding communication, sharp multitasking abilities, and a calm-under-pressure demeanor to tackle last-minute schedule changes.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:



1. Updated CV / Resume: Highlighting relevant experience in healthcare staffing, scheduling, or registry operations.



2.  1–2 Minute Video Introduction: Introduce yourself, share your relevant experience, and explain why you are an ideal fit for managing fast-paced healthcare scheduling and clinician coordination.



3. Availability & Preferred Schedule: Let us know your availability and readiness to start.

description:
ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst — NetSuite, Shopify & Integrations

FLUENT ENGLISH AND US WORKING HOURS REQUIRED



When applying - please answer the following questions: 

What NetSuite administration have you handled and for how long?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have coding, troubleshooting and maintaining SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.





------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 



We are a growing U.S.-based equipment and services company looking for a long-term ERP Systems Administrator / Technical Analyst to support our business systems and users.



Our primary systems include Oracle NetSuite, ManagerPlus (M+), Shopify and system integrations/APIs.



This is a hybrid systems administration + business systems + technical support role. It is NOT a virtual assistant position and is NOT purely a programming role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys figuring out how systems work, troubleshooting problems, supporting users, improving processes and doing light development/automation when needed.



What You Will Do



NetSuite Administration



Provide day-to-day NetSuite user and administrative support

Manage forms, fields, custom records, roles and permissions

Create and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards and KPIs

Support workflows / SuiteFlow

Assist with imports, data cleanup and master-data maintenance

Troubleshoot transaction, configuration and user issues



Integration & Systems Support



Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite, Shopify, ManagerPlus and other applications

Investigate failed or incorrect data synchronization

Review logs and error messages and identify root causes

Troubleshoot APIs, data mappings and integration processes

Test system changes and integrations before deployment

Coordinate with developers when more complex programming is required



Technical / Development



Create or modify basic SuiteScript / JavaScript where appropriate

Work with REST APIs, JSON and web services

Build simple automations and workflows

Understand existing scripts sufficiently to troubleshoot problems and make minor changes

Assist with testing and documenting more complex development performed by other developers



User Support & Adoption



Work directly with Finance, Operations, Purchasing, Service and Ecommerce users

Help users understand and correctly use the systems

Troubleshoot user-reported problems

Create clear process and system documentation

Help develop training materials

Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated

Help us improve system adoption and standardization

Required Skills

Hands-on NetSuite administration experience

Saved Searches and reporting

Custom forms, fields, records, roles and permissions

SuiteFlow / workflows

Strong ERP troubleshooting skills

Understanding of common ERP processes such as purchasing, sales orders, inventory and accounting

Experience working with system integrations

Basic understanding of APIs, REST, JSON and data mapping

Ability to read and understand JavaScript or similar programming

Strong problem-solving skills

Strong written and spoken English

Preferred Skills

SuiteScript 2.x / JavaScript

Shopify

Celigo or another integration/iPaaS platform

SuiteAnalytics / SQL

API integration experience

Experience with CMMS, work-order, field-service or equipment-management systems



ManagerPlus experience is NOT required. We will train the right person on this system.



Who Will Be Successful



We want someone who takes ownership of problems.



If a user says:



“This order did not transfer correctly from one system to another.”



We want you to be able to investigate the transaction, check the configuration and integration, review the logs, determine where it failed, fix what you can, and clearly explain what needs to happen next.



You should be comfortable moving between business users, ERP administration, data, integrations and code.



Position



Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours will be required

How to Apply





Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly with NetSuite?

What NetSuite administration tasks do you personally handle?

Describe one difficult NetSuite or ERP problem that you personally investigated and solved. What was wrong and how did you find it?

What experience do you have with SuiteScript, JavaScript, REST APIs or integrations?

Have you worked with Shopify, Celigo or another integration platform? Please describe.







Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically interested in understanding what you personally have configured, troubleshot, automated or developed.
