title: Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead
description:
We have ambitious plans to grow rapidly. Our entire ecosystem has been divided into 4 new positions. We are looking for people who have the knowledge and experience to join our team and take our 23 year old company to the next level.



Feel free to browse our 4 open positions, but do not apply to any if you do not have the experience required. Thanks you.



Here they are:



1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead

2. Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Performance Specialist

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



This ad is for position #4

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



Paid Social • Ecommerce Growth • Customer Acquisition • Retargeting • Lifecycle Marketing

Full-Time Permanent Position — 40 Hours Per Week

JOB OVERVIEW



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company looking for an exceptional Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead.



This is NOT a social-media posting position.

This is NOT a content-creator position.

We have separate employees responsible for creative production and staff who can assist with repetitive posting and routine engagement.



We are looking for the marketing brain.

You will be responsible for determining:



WHO we should market to.

WHAT we should market to them.

WHERE we should reach them.

WHEN we should reach them.

WHAT offer they should see.

WHAT stage of the buying journey they are in.

HOW much we should spend acquiring them.

HOW we bring them back if they don't purchase.

HOW we turn first-time customers into repeat customers.

WHETHER the marketing actually made money.



Our objective is not followers.

Our objective is profitable growth.



YOUR MISSION

Build a sophisticated digital customer-acquisition and retention engine capable of helping scale our company toward $10+ million in annual revenue.



No single employee can guarantee that revenue.



Your responsibility is to build, operate and continuously improve the digital-marketing systems that can help us get there.



The system should move customers through:



Awareness > Interest > Consideration > Visit > Lead/Cart > Purchase > Repeat Purchase > Referral



You will work closely with:



Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

Technical/Ecommerce SEO Lead

Paid Search Specialist

Management

Sales/customer-service staff

Social-media VA's



1. DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the complete social/digital marketing strategy.



Determine how we should use:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Pinterest

LinkedIn


SMS

Influencers

Creators

Customer lists

Retargeting

Marketing automation

Landing pages

CRM data



Do not advertise somewhere merely because it exists.



You must explain:



Why we're using it

Who we're targeting

What outcome we expect

How we're measuring it



2. CUSTOMER & MARKET SEGMENTATION

We sell products that can appeal to very different customers.



For custom shirts, examples may include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Contractors

Churches

Companies

Events

Clubs

Nonprofits

Family reunions

Gyms

Retail businesses



For yard signs:

Realtors

Contractors

Landscapers

Schools

Events

Graduations

Businesses

Political campaigns where appropriate

Property services

Community organizations



These audiences should NOT all receive the same advertisement.



Develop distinct:

Audiences

Messages

Offers

Creative briefs

Landing pages

Retargeting

Follow-up



3. CUSTOMER PERSONAS & BUYING INTENT



Understand:

Who buys

Why they buy

What problem they're solving

How quickly they need it

What prevents them from buying

What competitors they're considering

What matters most: price, speed, quality, convenience, service or customization

How often they reorder

What else they may purchase



Turn customer knowledge into marketing strategy.



4. META ADVERTISING



You must be highly experienced with:

Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

 Ads

Instagram Ads

Meta Pixel

Events Manager

Conversion API concepts

Custom audiences

Customer lists

Website audiences

Engagement audiences

Video audiences

Prospecting

Retargeting

Catalog ads where appropriate

Advantage+ tools where appropriate

Lookalike/similar audience strategies where available



You should know how to build campaigns from scratch and improve them over time.



5. TIKTOK MARKETING & ADVERTISING



Understand both organic TikTok behavior and TikTok Ads Manager.



Know how to:



Identify TikTok-native creative

Select objectives

Build campaigns

Develop audiences

Retarget

Test creative

Read performance

Use Pixel/Events data

Scale winners

Kill poor performers



Work closely with the Creative Lead to produce platform-native assets.



6. YOUTUBE



Develop opportunities through:



YouTube content

YouTube Shorts

Video advertising

Retargeting

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Customer-intent content



Determine which videos are brand-building and which are direct-response assets.



7. PINTEREST



Evaluate and utilize Pinterest when appropriate for visually driven products including:



Apparel

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING



Develop B2B opportunities where economically justified.



Potential audiences include:



Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

Schools

Organizations

Event companies

Contractors

Procurement teams



Determine when LinkedIn advertising makes financial sense and when organic outreach/content is more appropriate.



9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY



Own:



Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising +
/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.



Segment by:



Product purchased

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer



Use appropriately on supported platforms for:



Customer Match

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own
 strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING



Build compliant SMS programs for:



Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns



Avoid destroying customer trust through excessive messaging.



16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:



Business cards > flyers.



Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.



Develop data-driven cross-sell and upsell campaigns.



17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:



CAC

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form >
/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.



You DO need to understand what makes them convert.



Recommend:



Headlines

Offers

Layout

Social proof

Videos

Reviews

Calls to action

Forms

Product presentation

FAQs

Urgency

Guarantees

Mobile improvements



Work with our SEO/web team on implementation.



20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:



Percentage discounts

Dollar discounts

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

First-order incentives

Reorder incentives

Referral offers

Volume pricing

Seasonal promotions



Measure actual profitability.



21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING



Develop disciplined experiments around:



Creative

Hooks

Audiences

Offers

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

SMS

Retargeting windows

Campaign structures



Do not change ten things and then claim you learned something.



Test intelligently.



22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:



Zapier

CRM systems

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Webhooks/integrations where available

ManyChat

Other automation platforms



Example:



 Lead >



CRM >



Immediate SMS >



Immediate
 >



Sales notification >



Follow-up >



Retargeting audience >



Conversion tracking.



23. CRM STRATEGY



Help organize customers/leads by:



Source

Product interest

Stage

Customer type

Purchase history

Value

Follow-up status



Marketing should become smarter as our customer database grows.



24. INFLUENCER & CREATOR MARKETING



Own the business side of influencer/creator campaigns.



You determine:



Which creators make sense

Audience fit

Expected economics

Compensation structure

Affiliate opportunities

Tracking

Offers/codes

Content usage rights

Performance



Creative Lead owns/supports creative direction.



25. ORGANIC SOCIAL STRATEGY



Our VAs can perform repetitive posting.



You determine:



Platform strategy

Posting priorities

Content mix

Frequency

Campaign themes

Promotions

Audience development

Growth opportunities



Do not spend your entire day manually posting.



Your value is strategy and growth.



26. SOCIAL MEDIA VA MANAGEMENT



Create documented systems our VAs can execute.



Examples:



Posting calendar

Group-posting instructions

Response templates

Escalation rules

Comment procedures

Lead-capture procedures

CRM entry procedures



Use lower-cost execution resources intelligently so your own time remains focused on high-value marketing work.



27. ANALYTICS & ATTRIBUTION



Understand:



GA4

Meta attribution

TikTok attribution

Platform attribution differences

UTMs

Conversion events

CRM source data

Call tracking

Post-purchase surveys where useful

First-touch vs. last-touch

Assisted conversions



Do not blindly believe one dashboard.



Understand how measurement works.



28. CORE PERFORMANCE METRICS



You should be highly comfortable with:



Revenue

ROAS

MER

CPA

CAC

CPL

Cost per purchase

Conversion rate

Average order value

Customer lifetime value

Repeat purchase rate

CTR

CPC

CPM

Frequency

 revenue

SMS revenue



You must be able to explain these numbers to management in plain English.



29. BUDGET ALLOCATION



Recommend how marketing dollars should be distributed.



Example:



If Meta is producing 5X ROAS and TikTok is producing 1.2X, do not continue equal budgets because the original spreadsheet said so.



Evaluate:



Scalability

Incremental performance

Margins

Acquisition cost

Customer quality

Lifetime value

Seasonality



Move money intelligently.



30. SCALING



You must understand the difference between:



"A campaign works at $50/day" and: "We can profitably scale this campaign to $5,000/day."



Scaling requires monitoring:



Audience saturation

- Canva

- Adobe Photoshop

- AI tools

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Strong aesthetic sense



E-commerce / POD experience is a strong advantage. Shopify experience is a plus.

title: Content Editor & Strategist
description:
Content Editor & Strategist 



JOB TITLE: Content Editor & Strategist 



TYPE: Full time, remote, long term



HOURS: 40 hours per week, with some overlap with New York hours



SALARY: $800 to $1,100/month depending on experience



Read the whole post. There's an application instruction at the bottom and I skip anyone who misses it.



WHO WE ARE



A family-owned jeweler in New York City's Diamond District. Diamonds, engagement rings, and luxury watches, made in our own shop.



The footage is good and it's the kind most brands can't get. A real workshop, a real trading floor, and customers having the biggest day of their life on camera. Right now I shoot and edit all of it myself, and the editing is what's slowing everything down.



THE ROLE, IN ONE SENTENCE



I shoot. You make it good and tell me what to shoot next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Editing:



Cut short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Turn one shoot into several genuinely different videos, each with its own hook

Captions, on-screen text, pacing, sound, hook timing

Native edits per platform, no watermarked cross-posts

Keep the footage library organized



Strategy:



Watch the market weekly and bring me formats that are working before I ask

Bring me shoot ideas every week, not just execution of mine

Watch retention, sends, and non-follower reach, and tell me in plain language what you're seeing

Tell me when an idea is bad or a hook is weak. I'd rather argue for ten minutes than post something flat



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Someone who thinks like a creator, not a service provider.



Real short-form editing experience with links to prove it

You use TikTok and Reels yourself and have opinions about what's working

Strong written English. You'll be writing hooks and captions in an American voice

Organized and self-directed



You don't need a film degree, a jewelry background, or expensive gear. Most of our footage is shot on a phone on purpose.



WHO I'M NOT LOOKING FOR



An editor who slaps auto-captions on a clip, cuts wherever, adds a trending sound for no reason, and sends it back. That's the job I'm trying to stop doing myself.



I'm also not looking for someone who only ever agrees with me.



WHY THIS IS A GOOD ONE



Full time, stable, long term, with a real budget behind it

Tools and subscriptions paid for

You work directly with me. No layers, no account manager, no client calls

Your ideas actually get shot. This is a creative seat, not a queue

A luxury brand and a category you'll be proud to put in your portfolio

Raises tied to results

Path to leading a small content team



HOW TO APPLY



Two or three links to short-form videos you edited. One line each on what you were going for.

Answer this: pick any jewelry or luxury brand on TikTok or Instagram. Tell me one thing they're doing that works and one thing you'd change. Three sentences.

Start your message with the word DIAMOND.

description:
We're looking for an organized, personable Account Manager to own client relationships from onboarding through long-term retention. You'll be the main point of contact for our clients, making sure their experience is smooth, their concerns are handled quickly, and their accounts stay healthy.



This role starts with a training phase (client support) and grows into full account ownership as you build familiarity with our systems and clients.



**What you'll do:**



*Phase 1 – Client Support*

- Monitor and respond to client messages (calls, texts, CRM) through our GoHighLevel system

- Handle client inquiries on scheduling, workflows, and general support

- Triage client issues to the right internal team and document everything in Notion

- Track client billing through Stripe — payments, failures, upcoming due dates

- Keep detailed, organized notes on all client interactions



*Phase 2 – Onboarding & Training Exposure*

- Sit in on onboarding/training calls, take notes, and update client records

- Learn how successful client relationships are built and managed

- Review reports and flag performance gaps to supervisors

- Help prep talking points for upcoming client check-ins



*Phase 3 – Full Account Ownership*

- Serve as primary contact for assigned client accounts

- Run regular check-in calls to review performance, address concerns, and improve workflows

- Monitor billing and resolve payment issues proactively

- Spot early signs of client dissatisfaction and escalate with clear documentation

- Own client retention and long-term satisfaction



**Daily flow:** Morning message/payment review ? midday calls (onboarding, training, check-ins) ? end-of-day confirmations for next day's calls, all logged in Notion.



**Tools you'll use:**

- GoHighLevel (client communication & CRM)

- Notion (records, notes, tracking)

- Stripe (payment tracking)



**What we're looking for:**

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple client accounts

- Experience in client-facing roles (account management, customer success, or similar) is a plus

- Comfortable with CRM tools and documentation-heavy workflows

- Proactive — someone who catches problems before they escalate



**Schedule:** Full-time, US business hours

**Setup:** Own laptop/PC, stable internet, backup power/internet a plus



If this sounds like you, kindly send your updated CV along with a 1-2min self intro.

title: Bookkeeping / Data entry
description:
Virtual Assistant – Property Accounting & Utility Reconciliation

Full-Time or Part-Time | Long-Term Position | Real Estate Company



We are an established real estate investment, development, and property management company in Illinois, USA. We are looking for a highly organized, accurate, and dependable Virtual Assistant to help us with utility bill reconciliation, data entry, bookkeeping support, and property accounting.

This is intended to be a long-term position. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays close attention to numbers, stays on top of assignments, and does not need to be constantly reminded about unfinished tasks.

Initial Responsibilities



Your primary responsibilities will include:

Reviewing utility bills, including ComEd (electric), North Shore Gas, water/sewer, and other property utilities

Matching utility accounts and bills to the correct properties and units

Entering and organizing utility information

Reconciling bills, payments, and account records

Identifying missing bills, duplicate charges, incorrect property assignments, unusual charges, or discrepancies

Maintaining spreadsheets and utility/account tracking records

Entering and reviewing information in QuickBooks

Assisting with accounts payable and basic bookkeeping

Organizing invoices, statements, and other accounting documents

Following up on incomplete items and maintaining a clear list of outstanding issues

Providing regular updates on completed work and items requiring attention

As you learn our business and demonstrate your abilities, the position may expand into additional bookkeeping and accounting responsibilities.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Extremely detail-oriented and accurate with numbers

Organized and disciplined

Experienced with bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial data entry

Experienced with QuickBooks Online

Strong with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets

Comfortable reconciling accounts and investigating discrepancies

Able to work independently and stay focused

Able to follow established procedures consistently

Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense instead of guessing

Able to manage repetitive work without losing accuracy

Reliable with deadlines and follow-up

Interested in a stable, long-term working relationship

Experience working with a U.S. real estate, property management, bookkeeping, or accounting company is a major advantage.

Very Important

We are not simply looking for the fastest data-entry person.

Accuracy is more important to us than speed.

We want someone who will notice if:

A utility bill is assigned to the wrong property

An account number does not match

A bill appears to be missing

A payment does not reconcile

A charge is unusually high or low

The same bill appears twice

Something simply does not look correct

We value a person who will stop, investigate, and ask questions rather than enter incorrect information just to finish the task.

Software / Skills

Experience with the following is preferred:

QuickBooks Online

Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Google Drive

PDF invoices and statements


Basic accounting and bookkeeping principles



To Apply

Please include the following in your application:

How many years of bookkeeping/accounting experience do you have?

How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?

Have you worked for a U.S.-based company before?

Have you worked in real estate or property management?

Describe a reconciliation task you have handled in a previous position.

If you find that an invoice does not match the accounting records, what steps would you take?

What is your current availability and how many hours per week can you work?

At the very beginning of your application, write the words “UTILITY RECONCILIATION.” This is required so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our team. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibilities in bookkeeping and accounting.

title: Social Media + LinkedIn Outreach VA | Excellent Written English Required
description:
**Pay:** Around $3 USD per hour

**Hours:** Approximately 5-6 hours per day, Monday to Friday

**Working hours:** Must substantially overlap UK business hours

**Role:** Long-term



## About the Role



I run AI Services Essex, a UK business helping small businesses with professional websites, Voice AI receptionists and business automation.



I am looking for a reliable, highly organised and proactive VA to take responsibility for two important areas of the business:



1. LinkedIn outreach, lead follow-up and appointment setting

2. Growing and managing my
 and Instagram presence



This is **not simply a Canva or social media posting role**.



I need someone who is an excellent written communicator, organised, confident speaking with business owners and able to take ownership of a structured outreach process without needing constant supervision.



I already have my LinkedIn outreach messages, content plan, content ideas and brand guidelines prepared, so you will not be starting from scratch.



## LinkedIn Outreach & Lead Follow-Up



I connect with new business owners on LinkedIn every week.



You will manage my LinkedIn outreach directly and be responsible for moving prospects through an existing follow-up process.



This will include:



* Sending a prepared market research message to appropriate new connections

* Monitoring responses and replying naturally and professionally

* Following up at the correct time when someone has not replied

* Sending prepared Voice AI demonstration messages at the appropriate stage

* Sending a further follow-up approximately two weeks later where appropriate

* Sending our Smart Website demonstration message at the next stage

* Keeping conversations warm and friendly if someone says they are not interested

* Recognising when a conversation should be passed to me

* Making sure interested prospects move quickly to the next step

* Keeping every prospect accurately tracked



The initial outreach messages are already written.



However, when somebody responds, I need you to use good judgement and reply naturally rather than simply copying and pasting a script.



You will be communicating directly with UK business owners on my behalf, so your written English must be excellent.



Messages should sound **warm, mature, friendly and professional**. They should never sound robotic, overly salesy or too casual.



## LinkedIn Access



Direct management of my LinkedIn account is an important part of this role.



You must be:



* Comfortable securely accessing and managing my LinkedIn account as part of your daily work

* Comfortable using a UK VPN/secure connection that I provide where required

* Careful with account security and login details

* Able to work consistently from the agreed setup rather than changing devices or locations unnecessarily

* Confident handling conversations independently while knowing when to ask me before responding



## LinkedIn Prospect Tracking



I already have an existing LinkedIn prospect spreadsheet which may need some tidying up.



You will be responsible for keeping this completely up to date.



The tracker will include information such as:



* Prospect name

* Business name

* LinkedIn profile

* Date connected

* Date first outreach was sent

* Response received

* Follow-up dates

* Voice AI demonstration message sent

* Voice AI follow-up sent

* Smart Website message sent

* Current status

* Next action

* Notes

* Appointment booked



The aim is that at any time we can immediately see:



* Who needs contacting today

* Who needs following up

* Who has responded

* Who is interested

* Who is not interested

* Who has booked a call

* What the next action is



Accuracy and organisation are extremely important.



## Appointment Setting



When a prospect would like to:



* Have a market research call

* See a Voice AI receptionist demonstration

* See a Smart Website demonstration



You will arrange the appointment and put it into my calendar.



You will make sure the calendar appointment contains the information I need, including the prospect's name, company, reason for the call and any useful conversation notes.



You will then update the prospect tracker so the appointment and next steps are clearly recorded.



##
 & Instagram



I also want someone who can help me properly grow my social media presence.



You will help manage and grow:



* My personal
 profile

* AI Services Essex
 business page

* Instagram



This will include:



* Creating and repurposing content

* Creating Reels and short-form video content

* Creating posts and carousels where appropriate

* Writing captions and strong hooks

* Scheduling and publishing content

* Engaging with relevant business owners and accounts

* Responding to comments and messages

* Helping grow the accounts organically

* Looking for opportunities to start genuine conversations

* Monitoring what content performs well

* Suggesting ways to improve reach and engagement



I already have a large 180-day content plan, content topics, brand guidelines and content ideas available.



I do not need someone who simply creates pretty Canva graphics.



I want somebody who understands that the goal of social media is to increase **visibility, engagement, conversations and ultimately enquiries**.



##
 Groups & Communities



I am already a member of a number of relevant local
 Groups and business communities.



You will help manage this activity by:



* Posting suitable content in relevant groups

* Checking and following the rules of each group

* Engaging naturally with other members

* Checking previous posts for new comments or responses

* Responding appropriately

* Making sure potential opportunities are not missed

* Keeping a shared Google Sheet showing what has been posted and where



The
 Group tracker should make it easy for us to see:



* Group name

* Location

* Group link

* Posting rules

* Date last posted

* What was posted

* Comments or engagement received

* Replies completed

* Leads or opportunities generated

* Next action or next posting date



## Tracking & Reporting



I do not want to have to continually ask what has been done.



I am looking for somebody who takes ownership of their work and keeps me proactively updated.



You will maintain clear shared trackers covering:



* LinkedIn outreach sent

* Follow-ups due

* Responses received

* Interested prospects

* Zoom calls booked

*
 Group activity

* Social media content posted

* Engagement

* Account growth

* Leads or opportunities generated



I would also like a short regular progress update telling me:



* What has been completed

* What results have been achieved

* What conversations or opportunities need my attention

* What is planned next

* Any suggestions you have for improving results



## Working Hours



You must be available for approximately **5-6 hours per day, Monday to Friday**, with your working hours substantially overlapping normal UK business hours.



This is important because you will be:



* Responding to UK business owners

* Monitoring LinkedIn conversations

* Booking appointments

* Responding to social media engagement

* Monitoring
 Groups and comments



Please state the exact UK hours you would be available to work when you apply.



## You Must Have



* Excellent written English

* Strong organisation and attention to detail

* Excellent communication skills

* Experience managing social media

* Experience with
 and Instagram

* Experience with organic engagement and audience growth

* Confidence communicating with business owners

* Experience using Google Sheets

* Good follow-up skills

* Ability to follow a structured outreach process accurately

* Good judgement when responding to messages

* Ability to work independently

* A proactive attitude

* Canva experience

* Experience creating or editing Reels/short-form video

* Willingness to work substantially during UK business hours

* Comfort securely managing my LinkedIn account and using the agreed UK VPN setup



Experience with the following would be a strong advantage:



* LinkedIn outreach

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* CRM management

* Prospect tracking

* Community management



## Please Do Not Apply If



Please do not apply if:



* Your main experience is only graphic design or Canva

* You only schedule social media posts and do not understand engagement or organic growth

* Your written conversational English is not excellent

* You rely on generic copy-and-paste replies

* You need constant supervision to complete tasks

* You are not comfortable maintaining accurate trackers

* You struggle to follow structured follow-up processes

* You are unable to work substantially during UK business hours

* You are not comfortable managing LinkedIn outreach and conversations directly



## How to Apply



Please do **not** send me a generic application or CV without answering the questions below.



Start your application with the words:



**AI SERVICES ESSEX**



Then answer these questions:



1. What experience do you have with LinkedIn outreach, lead generation or appointment setting?



2. Have you ever managed another person's LinkedIn outreach or inbox? If yes, please explain what you were responsible for.



3. Tell me about a
 or Instagram account you have helped grow organically. What did you actually do and what was the result?



4. Have you managed a Google Sheet, CRM or prospect tracker containing follow-up dates and next actions? Please explain briefly.



5. If a LinkedIn prospect replied:



**“Thanks Alex, but it’s not something we need at the moment.”**



How would you reply?



6. What exact hours would you be available to work in **UK time**, Monday to Friday?



7. Are you comfortable securely managing my LinkedIn account and using a UK VPN/secure connection that I provide as part of the role?



8. Are you comfortable working approximately 5-6 hours per day at around **$3 USD per hour**?



Please also send a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this role, and briefly telling me about your experience with social media and LinkedIn outreach. Applications without a video will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **small paid test** before I make a final hiring decision.



I am looking for someone dependable who wants a long-term role and can become an important part of the business.

title: Talent Sourcer / Recruitment Specialist – Australian Trades & Field Service
description:
# Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator



**Remote – Philippines**

**Part-Time: Approximately 20 Hours Per Week Initially**

**Long-Term Position With Opportunity to Increase Hours**

**US$7–10/hour depending on experience + performance incentives**



## About the Role



We are a growing Australian business based in Adelaide, South Australia, looking for an experienced **Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator** to take ownership of our recruitment pipeline and assist with employee onboarding, training administration and people operations.



This is intended to be a **long-term position**, not a short-term recruitment project.



Our immediate priority is recruiting reliable field-service technicians for our Australian operations. However, as our business grows, you will also assist with recruitment for administration, sales, technology, management and offshore positions.



We are specifically looking for someone with genuine professional experience in:



* Recruitment

* Talent acquisition

* Candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Passive candidate outreach

* Candidate screening

* HR/people administration



This is **not a general VA position**.



You will work directly with the business owner and progressively become responsible for maintaining our recruitment systems, candidate database, onboarding processes and employee administration.



---



# Your Primary Responsibility: Recruitment & Headhunting



Traditional job advertisements do not always produce the calibre of candidates we require.



A major part of your role will therefore involve **proactively finding and approaching people who are already successfully employed**, rather than simply waiting for job applications.



You will:



* Research and identify suitable candidates

* Build targeted candidate lists

* Use LinkedIn and other platforms for candidate sourcing

* Conduct Boolean searches

* Identify passive candidates

* Directly approach potential employees

* Send personalised candidate outreach

* Follow up prospective candidates

* Conduct initial screening interviews

* Review employment histories

* Assess employment stability

* Identify reasons for previous job changes

* Assess communication and cultural fit

* Shortlist suitable candidates

* Coordinate management interviews

* Conduct reference checks where requested

* Maintain detailed candidate records

* Build a long-term talent pipeline



Our current Australian field-service recruitment particularly values candidates with:



* Stable employment histories

* Mechanical aptitude

* Field-service experience

* Ability to work independently

* Good customer communication

* Reliability

* Strong work ethic

* Long-term career intentions



Direct industry experience is helpful but **not always required**, because we have developed our own structured training program.



---



# Talent Mapping



We want to develop our own internal talent database rather than starting recruitment from zero every time we need an employee.



You will systematically identify potential employees across industries including:



* Pool and spa servicing

* Irrigation

* Pumps

* Water treatment

* Pest control

* Maintenance

* Facilities management

* Landscaping

* Field service

* Appliance servicing

* Technical services

* Trades and related industries



You will maintain records including:



* Candidate name

* Current position

* Current employer

* Employment tenure

* Previous employment

* Location

* Skills

* Contact history

* Interest level

* Salary expectations where known

* Suitability

* Follow-up dates

* Interview history

* Recruitment notes



Some candidates may not be ready to move immediately.



Your responsibility will be to build relationships and maintain a pipeline so that suitable candidates can be approached again in the future.



---



# Recruitment Across Our Business



Over time, you may assist with recruitment for:



### Australian Operations



* Field Service Technicians

* Senior Technicians

* Supervisors

* Operations staff

* Sales employees

* Account managers

* Administration

* Management roles



### Philippines / Remote Team



* Virtual Assistants

* Customer service employees

* Developers

* Designers

* Marketing employees

* Sales staff

* Other remote contractors



### Technology Businesses



Our company is also developing software products and technology businesses.



You may assist with sourcing:



* Full-stack developers

* Mobile developers

* UI/UX designers

* QA testers

* Product staff

* Customer success employees

* Sales representatives



---



# Employee Onboarding



Once a candidate is hired, you will help coordinate their onboarding.



Responsibilities may include:



* Preparing onboarding checklists

* Collecting required employee information

* Coordinating employment documentation

* Ensuring documentation has been returned

* Reference-check administration

* Licence/check verification

* Coordinating uniforms and equipment

* Scheduling onboarding activities

* Creating employee files

* Creating internal accounts/checklists

* Coordinating training

* Following up incomplete onboarding tasks

* Ensuring new employees are ready before commencement



You will not be responsible for providing Australian employment-law advice or making legal employment decisions.



---



# Training & Learning Administration



We have developed our own internal technician training program.



You will help administer the training system by:



* Enrolling employees in training

* Tracking module completion

* Tracking quiz results

* Identifying overdue training

* Maintaining training records

* Coordinating practical assessments

* Recording competencies

* Maintaining employee training files

* Scheduling refresher training

* Producing training progress reports

* Following up employees who fall behind



You will work with management and technical staff who provide the technical training and assessments.



---



# Employee Review Administration



You will help ensure employee reviews happen consistently rather than being forgotten during busy periods.



This may include organising:



* 7-day check-ins

* 30-day reviews

* 60-day reviews

* 90-day/probation reviews

* Six-month reviews

* Annual reviews



You may:



* Prepare review documents

* Gather employee feedback

* Collect manager feedback

* Maintain records

* Track agreed actions

* Schedule follow-up reviews



Final performance decisions remain with management.



---



# Employee Retention



As the role develops, you may assist management in understanding why employees stay or leave.



This may include:



* Employee check-ins

* Satisfaction surveys

* Identifying recurring concerns

* Exit interviews

* Recording resignation reasons

* Reporting employee-retention trends

* Identifying potential retention risks

* Monitoring employee tenure



The objective is to identify problems early rather than discovering them only when an employee resigns.



---



# Recruitment Marketing



You may also help improve how our businesses present themselves to prospective employees.



This could include:



* Writing and maintaining job advertisements

* Updating recruitment templates

* Managing careers-page content

* Creating employee testimonials

* Coordinating recruitment social-media posts

* Managing employee-referral programs

* Reviewing competitor job advertisements

* Researching salary ranges

* Tracking which recruitment channels produce the best employees



---



# Recruitment Reporting



We want recruitment decisions to become data-driven.



You will maintain reporting on metrics such as:



* Candidates sourced

* Candidates contacted

* Response rate

* Screening interviews

* Management interviews

* Offers made

* Offers accepted

* Cost per hire

* Time to hire

* Source of successful candidates

* Probation success rate

* Employee retention

* Reasons candidates reject offers



You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and recruitment databases.



---



# What We Are Looking For



You MUST have genuine recruitment, talent acquisition or candidate-sourcing experience.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



* LinkedIn Recruiter

* LinkedIn sourcing

* Boolean search

* Passive candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Cold candidate outreach

* Screening interviews

* Candidate databases / ATS systems

* Reference checking

* Recruitment reporting

* HR administration



Experience working with **Australian businesses** would be highly regarded.



Experience recruiting:



* Tradespeople

* Field-service employees

* Blue-collar workers

* Technical employees

* Engineers

* Construction workers

* Maintenance employees



would be particularly valuable.



---



# Personal Characteristics



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly organised

* Proactive

* Persistent

* Comfortable approaching people

* An excellent written communicator

* Confident speaking with candidates

* Good at assessing people

* Detail-oriented

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable challenging poor-quality candidates rather than simply progressing everyone

* Interested in building systems rather than simply completing individual tasks



We value **quality over activity**.



Sending 100 generic LinkedIn messages is not success.



Finding five excellent potential employees is.



---



# Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



The role will initially involve approximately **20 hours per week**.



For the right person, there is potential for:



* Increased hours

* Additional responsibility

title: Airbnb AirCover / STR Damage Claims Specialist
description:
# Airbnb AirCover / STR Damage Claims Specialist



**Remote | Philippines | Part-Time / Per-Claim**



I own and operate a **13-unit short-term rental property in Tacoma, Washington** and am looking for a highly experienced **Airbnb AirCover / Short-Term Rental Damage Claims Specialist**.



**This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.**



You will NOT be responsible for guest messaging, reservations, pricing, cleaning schedules, or day-to-day property management.



**Your primary responsibility is claims and reimbursement recovery.**



We have a separate Operations Manager and an established local cleaning team.



## What You Will Handle



You will take documented guest i
 and manage the reimbursement/claim process from beginning to end, including:



* Airbnb AirCover damage claims

* Airbnb Resolution Center reimbursement requests

* 
 guest-damage/reimbursement cases

* Smoking and marijuana remediation claims

* Excessive-cleaning claims where eligible

* Broken furniture

* Damaged beds and mattresses

* Damaged televisions/electronics

* Missing property

* Damaged linens and furnishings

* Unauthorized guest-caused damage

* Supporting documentation

* Repair/replacement estimates and receipts

* Guest reimbursement requests

* Platform follow-ups

* Claim escalations and appeals

* Tracking open claims until resolved

* Recording amounts claimed, approved, denied and recovered



## How Our System Will Work



Our local cleaning team will inspect units immediately following checkout.



When they discover damage or a serious violation, they will:



1. Stop before cleaning or removing the evidence.

2. Take photographs/video.

3. Document what they found.

4. Report the i
 through our operating system.



Our Operations Manager will handle the immediate property issue and make sure the unit is ready for the next guest.



**You take over the reimbursement side.**



Your job is to review the evidence, determine what additional documentation is needed, prepare the strongest legitimate claim possible, submit it correctly and follow it until there is a final resolution.



## I Am Looking for a Specialist



I strongly prefer candidates with:



* Extensive hands-on Airbnb AirCover experience

* Airbnb Resolution Center experience

* Experience handling STR property-damage claims

* Experience with smoking/remediation claims

* Experience appealing denied or underpaid claims

* Strong knowledge of Airbnb's documentation and claim deadlines

* Experience with 
 claims/reimbursement procedures

* Excellent written English

* Strong documentation and organizational skills



### Former Airbnb employees are strongly encouraged to apply.



I am particularly interested in former:



* Airbnb Resolution Center representatives

* AirCover support specialists

* Airbnb claims representatives

* Airbnb escalations representatives

* Airbnb Trust & Safety/support personnel with reimbursement experience



## Compensation



I am open to:



* Hourly compensation

* A fixed amount per claim

* A monthly part-time arrangement

* Another structure that makes sense based on actual claim volume



This is **not intended to be a full-time position**.



I am more interested in finding someone exceptionally good at recovering legitimate claims than hiring someone for a certain number of hours.



## To Apply



Please answer **all** of the following:



1. How many years have you handled Airbnb/STR damage claims?

2. Approximately how many Airbnb AirCover or Resolution Center claims have you personally handled?

3. Were you ever employed directly or indirectly supporting Airbnb? If yes, what was your position?

4. What types of claims have you handled?

5. What is the largest claim you have personally managed?

6. Have you handled smoking or marijuana remediation claims?

7. Have you handled 
 guest-damage cases?

8. Have you appealed denied Airbnb claims?

9. Give an example of a difficult claim that was initially denied or disputed and explain what you did to resolve it.

10. What documentation do you want from a cleaner when guest damage is discovered?

11. What evidence would you require for an indoor-smoking remediation claim?

12. How do you determine the appropriate amount to claim for damaged property?

13. How do you track claim deadlines and follow-ups?

14. Approximately what percentage of the legitimate claims you've handled resulted in reimbursement?

15. What compensation structure would you prefer?



### Scenario



A guest checks out at 11:00 AM.



Our cleaner enters the unit and immediately reports a strong marijuana odor. She photographs ash and smoking evidence. She also discovers that the bed frame has been broken.



Another guest is checking in that afternoon.



The Operations Manager handles getting the property ready for the incoming guest.



**Your responsibility begins with the claim.**



Please explain exactly what evidence you would request, what reimbursement claims you would pursue, how you would document the amounts requested, and how you would handle the case if the guest denies everything.



Please answer based on **your actual claims experience**, not a generic explanation of how AirCover works.



Begin your application with the words:



**CLAIMS SPECIALIST**



Applications from general VAs without substantial claims experience will not be considered.

The ideal candidate will work directly with our leadership team to provide procurement walkthroughs, identify requirements, review opportunities, and help ensure contract and proposal submissions are complete, compliant, accurate, and competitive.

- Procurement Leadership: Guide leadership through California state procurement and contracting processes.

- Portal & Agency Navigation: Assist with navigating DGS Procurement Division and Cal eProcure.

- Solicitation Review: Review statewide contract opportunities, RFQs, RFPs, IFBs, and other solicitations.

- Compliance & Requirements: Help determine eligibility and submission requirements for individual opportunities.

- Checklists & Timelines: Develop submission checklists, timelines, and required-document lists.

- Proposal & Bid Audits: Review bid and proposal packages for completeness and compliance.

- Registrations & Certifications: Assist with vendor registrations, certifications, and government documentation.

- Opportunity Identification: Help identify applicable statewide contracts and government purchasing opportunities.

- Team Training: Provide hands-on walkthroughs and training to our internal team.

- Tracking & Management: Assist with tracking deadlines, renewals, amendments, and contracting requirements.

- Process Development: Help KoreVia Solutions establish a repeatable internal process for future government contract submissions.



Qualifications

- Prior experience with California state government procurement, contracting, purchasing, or vendor management.

- Working knowledge of California DGS Procurement Division and/or Cal eProcure.

- Experience reviewing or responding to government solicitations.

- Strong understanding of government contracting documentation and compliance requirements.

- Excellent organizational and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex procurement requirements in a clear, practical manner.

- Comfortable working directly with company leadership on an as-needed basis.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



- California statewide contracts

- DGS Procurement Division & Cal eProcure

- CMAS (California Multiple Award Schedules)

- Small Business (SB) / DVBE contracting

- Healthcare or medical staffing contracts

- Professional services contracts

- Federal government contracting (
, U.S. Dept of Veterans Affairs, RFP/solicitation responses)



Engagement Structure

We are open to candidates seeking:

Part-Time | Per Diem | Independent Consulting | Project-Based Support



This is an excellent opportunity for a current or former government procurement professional, contracts specialist, procurement consultant, or experienced public-sector contracting professional looking for flexible project-based work.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit:



1. Current Resume: Highlight relevant California government procurement, contracting, DGS, Cal eProcure, or federal contracting experience.



2. 1–2 Minute Video Introduction: Tell us why this position would be an ideal fit for your experience, what you can bring to our government contracting efforts, and why you would like to be part of KoreVia Solutions.



3. Experience Summary: Briefly describe your experience with DGS, Cal eProcure, statewide contracts, government solicitations, or proposal submissions (including successful government contracting projects where applicable).



4. Availability: Let us know whether you are interested in part-time, per diem, consulting, or project-based work.



We are looking for someone who can bring both hands-on government procurement expertise and a genuine interest in helping KoreVia Solutions expand our public-sector partnerships.

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.



To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items



1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you are the person we are looking for.



2. Your current résumé.



3. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service, inside sales, office administration, or social media experience.



4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part time schedule and transition into the required full time Mountain Time schedule.



5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.



6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule.



8. Your brief answer to this question:



A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next?



Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them.



Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Best,



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: Graphic Designer (Web Design + Ad Creative)
description:
About the Role



We are an SEO agency serving local service businesses and ecommerce brands across the US. We are hiring a full-time Graphic Designer who can build beautiful, conversion-focused websites and brand assets for our clients, with SEO built into every page from the start rather than bolted on afterward.



This is not a "make it pretty" design role. You will be building real pages, mainly on WordPress with some Wix and Squarespace, that are designed to rank and convert. You will also create ad creative for paid campaigns and support our internal marketing materials.



If you like ownership, variety, and seeing your work drive actual results for real businesses, this is a good fit.



What You'll Own



1. Client Website and Page Design



Design and build client website pages on WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace

Structure pages with SEO fundamentals in mind: heading hierarchy, image optimization, page speed, mobile responsiveness, and internal linking opportunities

Mock up new website designs for existing clients and for new SEO sites

Work from client briefs and brand direction to create pages that look professional and turn visitors into leads



2. Ad Creative



Create ad graphics for paid campaigns, including static display ads, social ad creative, and multiple variations for A/B testing. Work on campaign creative, which means you should be comfortable taking direction and turning around several concepts quickly.



3. Brand Guidelines and Identity



Build brand guideline documents for new clients as they onboard, covering color palettes, typography, logo usage, and voice and tone direction. Create brand systems from scratch for companies that do not have one. Keep every page and asset we produce for a client visually consistent.



4. Speed and Systems



Use automation and AI tools to build pages faster. We are not looking for someone who designs every page by hand from scratch. We want someone who builds reusable templates and components, works efficiently inside page builders and automation tools, and is always looking for ways to cut production time without cutting quality.



5. Internal Design



Support internal marketing design, including social graphics, ad creative, presentation decks, and sales materials

Help keep the brand sharp across every touchpoint.



What We Need From You

- Several years of real design experience. Not a beginner, and not "I took a course." We need someone who has actually shipped client work.

- A portfolio you can show us. This is required with your application, not optional. No portfolio, no consideration.

- Strong working knowledge of WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace page building

- A practical understanding of on-page SEO. You do not need to be a technical SEO expert, but you should know why heading structure, alt text, and page speed matter.

- Hands-on experience with automation, AI design tools, or templating systems to speed up output. Tell us specifically which tools you use and how they have cut your turnaround time.

- Confidence building brand guidelines from scratch for a brand new client

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Add design26 to your application to be considered

- Reliable, deadline-driven, and able to manage several client projects at once



Bonus Skills



- Shopify store design and theme customization

- Logo design for clients who need one built from the ground up

- Familiarity with Claude's AI design features as part of your workflow



Schedule and Pay



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Base Pay: $1,000 per month



Bonuses on top of base for:

- Client retention

- Completed tasks and fast project turnaround

- Exceptional work quality

- Shopify design projects

- Use of Claude's AI design tools in your workflow



How to Apply



Send all of the following:

- Your resume or CV

- Your design portfolio, with the link included directly in your application

- A short cover note explaining why you are a strong fit for this specific role

- A section titled "Why I Stand Out." This is your chance to show us what separates you from every other applicant. Be specific, be confident, and point us to your best work.



Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.



By applying, you consent to us reviewing your portfolio and application materials, and contacting any references you provide.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. Real client work, real creative ownership, and a clear path to more responsibility and more pay as you prove yourself.
