title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience

U.S. Home Health experience

title: Sales VA
description:
Outbound Sales VA for Australian Cleaning Company - Cold Calls + Cold
 | Experienced Only | Immediate Start



We're Builders Clean, a Sydney post-construction cleaning and caulking company. We clean for 200+ builders including some of the biggest names in NSW, and we're growing fast. We're hiring two full-time outbound sales VAs, long-term, starting immediately — if you're selected, you'll be on the phones within days, with a call sheet already loaded and waiting.



The job, plainly:

Your mornings are on the phone: calling Australian builders from a prepared call sheet in our custom dashboard. Every lead comes pre-loaded — company name, contact, phone, address, background. You call, you have a real conversation, and when a builder is interested, you book them in for a quote.



Your afternoons are in the inbox: sending outreach
s from our proven templates, personalising them to each builder, chasing non-responders, and replying same-day when someone bites.



Everything logs in one dashboard. No list building, no spreadsheet marathons — leads arrive ready, you turn them into booked quotes.



How you'll be measured:

One number: quotes booked per week — from calls or
s, we don't care which. Not dials, not
s sent, not hours online. If you like being judged on results, you'll like it here.



You're right for this if:

- You have real outbound experience — cold calling, appointment setting, or cold
, ideally 1+ years

- Your spoken English is clear, warm and confident, and your written English matches

- You can hear "not interested" twenty times and dial twenty-one the same way you dialled number one

- You're reliable: when your shift starts, you're on — with backup internet and backup power for when Manila weather disagrees



Hours: Full-time, 9:00am–5:30pm Sydney time (AEST) — builders answer early. Your schedule follows Australian time. This role is exclusive: no other clients during these hours.



Pay: base salary + a bonus for every quote you book. Book well, earn well. Paid on time, every time.



How to apply — the checklist IS the first test. Incomplete applications will not be read:



1. 60-second voice recording — sell us anything: a product, a place, yourself.

2. A cold
, under 100 words, written to a Sydney builder introducing a cleaning company. Subject line included.

3. Your last outbound campaign, with numbers: what you sold, to which country, dials or
s per day, and one result you're proud of — with the actual number.

4. Your last three roles with dates, and why each ended.

5. One reference we can message (past client or team lead) + your OnlineJobs.ph or LinkedIn profile.

6. Screenshot of a speed test, plus one line describing your backup internet and backup power.

7. (Optional, but it moves you to the front of the line): a recording of yourself on a real or mock sales call from a previous role.

8. Your earliest start date — we're hiring this week.

title: Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist – Medicaid / Claims Experience Required
description:
Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist – Medicaid / Claims Experience Required



Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Long-Term Position | U.S.-Based Home Care Agency



About Us



Zeabe is a U.S.-based non-medical Home Care Agency serving clients in Delaware.



We are looking for an experienced Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist to take ownership of key billing, claims, accounts receivable, authorization, and payroll processes.



This is not a general virtual assistant, bookkeeping, or data-entry role.



We need someone who understands that billing does not end when a claim is submitted.



If a claim should have paid $1,000 and only $700 was received, we expect you to determine why, correct the issue, and follow it through until it is resolved.



Work Schedule

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week

Remote from the Philippines

Night shift aligned substantially with U.S. Eastern Time business hours 8am to 4:30pm EST

Permanent, long-term position



Key Responsibilities

Home Care Billing & Claims

Finalize billing cycles and review billable visits before claims are generated.

Submit and monitor electronic healthcare claims.

Investigate rejected, denied, unpaid, partially paid, and underpaid claims.

Correct, adjust, or resubmit claims where required.

Reconcile expected reimbursement against actual payments received.

Follow outstanding claims through to final resolution.

Medicaid & VA Billing



You will work with payers including:



AmeriHealth Caritas Delaware

Highmark Health Options

Delaware First Health

U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs



Responsibilities include reviewing authorizations, hours, units, rates, service dates, payer requirements, and resolving billing discrepancies.



Previous Medicaid Managed Care or VA billing experience is highly desirable.



Accounts Receivable

Review ERA/EOB information and reconcile payments.

Monitor AR aging and unpaid claims.

Investigate underpayments and payment discrepancies.

Follow up on outstanding balances and payer issues.

Payroll

Prepare and process caregiver and office payroll.

Reconcile worked hours against payable hours.

Review rates, PTO, bonuses, adjustments, and other payroll items.

Investigate discrepancies before payroll is finalized.



Required Experience



We are looking for approximately 4+ years of relevant billing or claims experience in one or more of the following:



U.S. Home Care billing

U.S. Home Health billing

Medicaid billing

Medicare billing

U.S. healthcare revenue cycle or claims management



Home Care or Home Health billing experience is strongly preferred.



Your experience should include working claims after submission, including areas such as:



Rejections and denials

Partial payments and underpayments

Corrected or adjusted claims

ERA/EOB reconciliation

AR follow-up



If your billing experience stops once a claim has been submitted, this is probably not the right role.



Strongly Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:



Medicaid Managed Care Organizations

VA billing

Waystar or another healthcare clearinghouse

AlayaCare or another Home Care platform

Payer portals

Payroll for hourly or field-based employees

QuickBooks

BambooHR



We can train you on our specific systems. What matters most is that you already understand healthcare billing, claims investigation, and financial reconciliation.



You May Be a Great Fit If...

You notice when numbers do not reconcile.

An unexplained $37 difference bothers you until you understand it.

You enjoy investigating why something happened.

You like closing open loops.

You naturally double-check important work.

You prefer accuracy over simply getting something off your desk.

You work well independently and follow structured processes.

You take responsibility for the final outcome, not just your part of the process.

This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If...



Your experience is mainly:



General virtual assistance

Data entry

Basic bookkeeping

Accounts payable

Payroll without healthcare billing experience

Administrative support

Claim entry without responsibility for denials, AR, or payment resolution

Technical Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet home workspace

Reliable computer

Working headset and webcam

Reliable availability during scheduled hours



Backup power and internet are strongly preferred.



What We Value



We value people who:



Own the Outcome

Get It Done

Choose Clarity Over Ambiguity

Fix the System

Stay Curious

Compensation



USD $1,400–$1,800 per month, depending on directly relevant U.S. Home Care, Medicaid, VA, billing, claims, and payroll experience.

Billing & Payroll

title: Short Form Video Editor (AI Generation/Sneakers/Nike)
description:
WHAT THIS ROLE IS



I run a content brand built around the niche of Sneakers in short-form video — reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. I need a dedicated editor who can take raw footage and turn it into fast, polished videos that feel native to the platform. Pacing, hooks, sound design, and audience retention matter more here than fancy effects. If you've only edited long-form or corporate content, this probably isn't the right fit.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Edit raw footage into short-form videos (15–90 sec) optimized for reels and TikTok

- Curate AI video generation clips. You will filter out which AI clips are good, and bad.

- Handle cuts, captions, editing with the videos

- Adapt quickly to new topics and content styles as the brand evolves

- Bonus: write or refine scripts — hooks, transitions, CTAs

- Bonus: experience with AI video generation tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, CapCut AI, etc.)

- HIGH BONUS: Understand the nature of Sneakers, SNKRS, Nike, Sneaker Reselling, Hyped Sneaker Colorways, Etc



---



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years editing short-form content professionally (not just personal projects)

- Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve — provable in your portfolio

- Strong sense of pacing and what keeps viewers watching past the first 3 seconds

- Reliable internet, consistent power, and a schedule that overlaps with US Central Time

- Clear written English — you need to communicate async without needing to be chased

- Portfolio of 5+ short-form videos you personally edited (required — no portfolio = no review)

-BONUS: Good understanding of the Sneaker Industry (Nike, Adidas, Jordans, SNKRS, etc)



---



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter. Answer all three questions below. Applications that skip questions or don't include a portfolio link will not be opened.



Share a Google Drive or YouTube link to at least 3 short-form videos you personally edited. For each video, write 1–2 sentences explaining your specific contribution — did you script it? Handle audio? Do the captions? Be specific. Do not link a general website or Instagram page — link the actual videos.



Why should you work for us? Describe yourself, your work ethic, and clear examples how you can make that up.



---



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Qualified applicants will receive a paid trial edit — one raw clip, your cut, compensated. If it's a match, we move to a 30-day trial and then long-term. I give direct feedback, consistent work, and pay on time every time. This is a 1:1 role — you work directly with me, not through an agency or middleman.



For any questions, message me under this application.

* Licensed CPA in the Philippines

* Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience independently managing books for multiple entities

* Strong bank and credit card reconciliation skills

title: Quality Control Reviewer: Short-Form Video (Detail-Heavy, Part-Time)
description:
We're a video distribution agency working with US stand-up comedians. We produce short-form clips for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. We need someone to review every clip before it goes out and catch the mistakes.



This is not a creative role. You're not editing and you're not giving opinions on style. You're checking work against a fixed standard and reporting what's wrong.



What you'll do:

- Review 120–200 short videos per week against a written checklist

- Catch caption errors where the text doesn't match what the comedian actually said

- Check client name spellings, thumbnail formatting, and text placement

- Report every issue with timestamps in a set format

- Approve what's clean without flagging things that are fine



What we need:

- Excellent listening comprehension in American English. Most errors are a single wrong word in a caption, the comedian says one thing, the auto-caption says another. You need to hear the difference over crowd noise.

- Extreme attention to detail. Some mistakes are one character.

- Ability to follow a checklist exactly rather than using your own judgment.

- Reliable weekly availability.



Hours and pay:

- Around 6 hours per week to start

- $10/hour to start, moving to $12/hour once you're up to speed and hitting our accuracy standard.

- Rate increases based on accuracy after the trial period

- Long-term position with more hours likely as we grow



Hiring process:

- Application

- Unpaid screening test: 20 clips, 30–45 minutes, with a full video walkthrough of the job

- Short video call

- Paid 2-week trial at full rate

- Permanent hire



To apply: Begin your message with the word ACCURACY, then answer this in one paragraph:



Tell me about the smallest mistake you've ever caught in someone else's work. Be specific about what it was.



Applications with spelling or grammar errors will not be considered. Applications that don't begin with ACCURACY will not be read.

title: Social Media Manager & Video Editor (Real Estate, CapCut + Sprout Social)
description:
I am a real estate broker in Colorado, USA, running a personal brand built on neighborhood and lifestyle content. I publish short-form vertical reels, mid-form YouTube videos, a monthly
 newsletter, and a local events guide.



I am looking for one person to own social media end to end. Not just posting. Owning it. You will run the content calendar, edit the video, publish across platforms through Sprout Social, and tell me what is working and what to do more of.



Important: this is a hands-on production role. You will spend most of your week inside an editing timeline. I am not looking for someone who directs a team or subcontracts the editing. If you do not personally edit video every day, please do not apply.



Salary will be $700 - $900 USD/mo based on experience and portfolio



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Social media ownership:

- Own and run the content calendar across Instagram,
, YouTube, and TikTok

- Manage scheduling and publishing through Sprout Social

- Write captions in my established brand voice (I will give you a voice guide)

- Report monthly on what performed and recommend what we do more of



Video production:

- Edit vertical short-form video from raw footage I send you

- Add styled text overlays, captions, b-roll, and music to match my brand look

- Cut long-form YouTube footage into multiple short clips

- Manage YouTube uploads, titles, descriptions, tags, and thumbnails



Supporting work:

- Build graphics and templates in Canva using my existing brand kit

- Build and send monthly newsletters in MailerLite from copy I provide



REQUIRED:

- 2+ years running social media for a business or personal brand, including doing the editing yourself

- Strong working knowledge of CapCut Pro. This is where my footage lives.

- Experience with a social scheduling platform. Sprout Social preferred, but Hootsuite, Later, or Buffer experience transfers.

- Canva proficiency

- Clean written English. You will write captions in my voice, and voice matters more to me than almost anything else in this role.

- A computer and internet connection that handle large video files without hours of transfer time

- Reliable power backup

- Available for a short daily check-in at the start of my business day



NICE TO HAVE:

- Real estate, hospitality, or travel content experience

- MailerLite or similar
 platform experience

- TubeBuddy or YouTube channel growth experience

- Adobe Premiere or DaVinci Resolve in addition to CapCut

- Meta 
 and Instagram) ads experience, particularly under Meta's Special Ad Category rules for housing. Paid ads are not part of this role today, but may be added later for the right person.



HOW I WORK:

I give clear direction and I expect clear communication back. If something is going to be late, I want to hear it before the deadline, not after. I will hand you real ownership of this channel. Meet that standard and this is a stable, long-term role with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY:

description:

Spanish

title: AMAZON ADVERTISING GROWTH MANAGER Health & Household | Remote | Part-Time
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY



We are a growing e-commerce company with proven products in the Amazon Health & Household category.



This product line has already generated more than $100,000 per month in sales. We are now relaunching it on a new Amazon account and plan to scale aggressively.



The demand already exists. Your job is to build the advertising system that captures it profitably.



You will work directly with the owner inside a small company that moves quickly. We care about getting the right campaigns launched, learning from the numbers and making intelligent decisions quickly.



We are not looking for someone to simply monitor campaigns or change bids when asked. We want an experienced operator who can understand the goal, build the strategy and bring us recommended solutions—not just problems.



YOUR MISSION



Build and manage an Amazon PPC system that profitably relaunches and scales our proven Health & Household products.



Your first priority will be setting up several campaigns this weekend, so you must be available to begin immediately.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE



Within your first 72 hours:



* Understand our products, margins, previous performance and objectives

* Establish initial ACOS, TACoS and profitability targets

* Build and launch the priority campaigns

* Create a simple scoreboard showing whether we are moving in the right direction



Within your first 30 days:



* Establish a clean, scalable campaign structure

* Identify converting keywords and product targets

* Eliminate obvious wasted spending

* Increase qualified traffic and sales

* Provide clear recommendations based on the data

* Show us exactly what is working, what is not working and what should happen next



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



* Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display when appropriate

* Keyword, competitor and product-targeting research

* Campaign structure, bids, budgets and placements

* Search-term harvesting and negative targeting

* CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ACOS, TACoS and contribution profitability

* Scaling successful campaigns without losing control of efficiency

* Diagnosing whether performance problems come from advertising, pricing, the listing, reviews or another conversion issue

* Short weekly updates focused on results, lessons and next actions



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You must have personally managed at least $50,000 per month in Amazon PPC ad spend—not merely an account generating $50,000 in sales.



The right person:



* Has proven Amazon PPC results at meaningful scale

* Understands the Health & Household category

* Thinks in terms of profit and total account growth—not ACOS alone

* Makes decisions using data without waiting for perfect information

* Takes responsibility when something does not work

* Brings multiple solutions and recommends the best one

* Communicates clearly and does not require constant supervision

* Can move quickly without becoming careless



COMPENSATION AND ROLE DETAILS



* Approximately 10 hours per week to start

* $10 per hour

* A small profit share will be offered immediately to directly incentivize results

* Paid gym time included because we believe physical health supports strong performance

* Remote position

* Immediate start with availability this weekend

* Current employment is completely fine as long as there is no conflict of interest and you can meet your commitments

* Potential to grow into a full-time position if your results demonstrate that you are an A player



HOW TO APPLY



Message me at +1 (615)
if interested.



Include your résumé, a short introduction, your earliest starting time and your availability this weekend. You should also answer the following seven questions using real numbers and specific examples.



An anonymized screenshot or screen recording showing that you have managed at least $50,000 in monthly Amazon PPC spending is strongly encouraged. Confidential product and client information may be hidden.



1. Using one real account, explain the largest monthly Amazon PPC budget you personally managed, including its sales, ACOS, TACoS, starting performance, your specific changes and the final results.

2. If you received access to our account today, what would you accomplish during your first 72 hours and first 30 days?

3. What initial sales, ACOS, TACoS and profitability targets would you establish for this relaunch, and which business inputs would you use to set them?

4. After three, seven and 14 days, how would you know whether we were moving in the right direction, including the exact leading and lagging metrics you would track?

5. Describe a real campaign that missed its targets, including how you diagnosed the problem, the solutions you considered, the change you selected and what happened afterward.

6. Why does this particular opportunity fit what you want from your career right now?

7. Do you consider yourself a lucky person, and what experiences caused you to see yourself that way?

title: Virtual Receptionist - Real Estate & Mortgage Brokerage
description:
We are looking for a friendly, professional, energetic, and extremely dependable **Virtual Receptionist VA** to serve as the first point of contact for our real estate and mortgage clients.



Your primary responsibility is simple:



**Make sure every incoming lead and client receives a fast, professional response and gets connected to the correct person or next step.**



You will handle incoming calls, missed-call follow-up, appointment scheduling, basic lead qualification, CRM updates, and client communication.



YOUR ROLE

You may speak with:



* Home buyers

* Home sellers

* Mortgage borrowers

* Homeowners interested in refinancing

* Real estate investors

* Rental clients

* Realtors

* Lenders

* Title companies

* Vendors

* Existing clients

* Past clients

* Referral partners



You must be comfortable speaking with people throughout the day.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Incoming Calls**



* Answer incoming business calls

* Professionally greet callers

* Determine why they are calling

* Collect necessary information

* Route calls appropriately

* Take detailed messages

* Schedule appointments

* Update CRM records immediately



**Missed Calls**



* Return missed calls quickly

* Send follow-up text messages when appropriate

* Identify whether the caller is a new lead or existing client

* Document the outcome

* Create appropriate follow-up tasks



**Lead Qualification**



For real estate leads, you may ask questions such as:



* Are you looking to buy, sell, or rent?

* What area are you interested in?

* What is your price range?

* When are you looking to move?

* Are you already working with an agent?

* Do you need financing?



For mortgage leads:



* Are you purchasing or refinancing?

* What type of property?

* Approximate purchase price?

* Approximate down payment?

* Have you already completed a loan application?

* When are you hoping to close?



You are NOT expected to provide mortgage advice or quote loan terms unless specifically authorized.



Your job is to **collect information and move the prospect to the correct next step.**



APPOINTMENT SETTING

You will help schedule:



* Buyer consultations

* Seller consultations

* Listing appointments

* Property showings

* Mortgage consultations

* Pre-approval appointments

* Client follow-up calls

* Partner meetings



You will confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows.



CRM MANAGEMENT

You will:



* Add new leads

* Update existing contacts

* Record call notes

* Apply tags

* Update lead stages

* Create follow-up tasks

* Record appointment dates

* Identify urgent leads

* Alert the appropriate team member

* Maintain clean and accurate contact records



CLIENT FOLLOW-UP

You may also:



* Call new internet leads

* Follow up with unanswered inquiries

* Confirm that clients received
s/documents

* Remind clients about appointments

* Contact older leads

* Reconnect with past clients

* Follow up with referral partners

* Request reviews after successful transactions



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You are:



* Friendly

* Energetic

* Professional

* Patient

* Confident on the phone

* Excellent at spoken English

* Easy to understand

* Organized

* Reliable

* Comfortable following scripts

* Comfortable handling objections

* Comfortable speaking with strangers

* Able to multitask

* Fast at entering notes while talking

* Comfortable using CRMs and web-based software



ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS

Because you will regularly speak with U.S.-based clients, **excellent spoken English is extremely important.**



Your accent does NOT need to be American.



However, callers must be able to understand you clearly and comfortably.



EXPERIENCE PREFERRED

Experience in any of these industries is helpful:



* Real Estate

* Mortgage

* Call Center

* Customer Service

* Appointment Setting

* Inside Sales

* Reception

* Lead Qualification

* Virtual Assistance



Real estate or mortgage experience is preferred but not mandatory for an exceptional communicator.



TECHNOLOGY

Experience with these tools is helpful:



* Follow Up Boss or another CRM

* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Calendar

* VoIP / cloud phone systems

* Slack

* ClickUp

* Zoom

* Calendly or appointment scheduling software



Training will be provided for company-specific procedures.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

We expect:



* Calls answered professionally

* Missed calls returned quickly

* New leads contacted promptly

* Accurate CRM notes

* Appointments booked correctly

* Follow-up tasks completed

* Clients treated professionally

* Urgent matters escalated immediately

* Minimal leads falling through the cracks



VERY IMPORTANT

We are NOT looking for someone who simply answers the phone and says:



“I'll leave a message.”



We want someone who thinks:



**“How can I move this person to the next step?”**



That may mean:



Incoming Lead

? Qualification

? CRM Entry

? Appointment

? Broker/Agent/Loan Team

? Follow-Up



Every conversation should have a clear outcome or next action.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to be a long-term position.



Strong performers may eventually grow into roles involving:



* Inside Sales

* Lead Management

* Client Success

* CRM Management

* ISA Team Leadership

* Operations



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your receptionist/call center/customer service experience.

3. Any U.S. real estate or mortgage experience.

4. Your current availability.

5. Your desired hourly rate.

6. Your computer specifications.

7. Your internet speed.

8. A link to your resume/CV.



**VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED**



Please include a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for a receptionist position.



Start your application with:



**“HELLO PURE EQUITY”**



Applications without the phrase and voice recording may not be considered.



We are looking for a **dependable long-term team member who takes ownership of every call and every lead.**

title: Remote Appointment Setter / Cold Caller / Business Development Representative (BDR) / SDR
description:

We build, train, and manage dedicated outbound sales teams that generate qualified meetings for SaaS, technology, and professional service companies.



Our success is built on meaningful conversations. Every call has the potential to open new opportunities for our clients, and that's why we're looking for sales professionals who enjoy connecting with people, overcoming objections, and creating value through outbound outreach.



If you're competitive, resilient, and motivated by results, you'll fit right in.



About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the first voice prospects hear on behalf of our clients. Your role is to engage decision-makers, uncover business needs, qualify opportunities, and schedule meetings for client sales teams.



You'll support multiple outbound campaigns while working within structured processes, receiving regular coaching, and sharpening your prospecting skills every day.



This opportunity is well suited for someone who enjoys fast-paced sales environments, remains resilient through rejection, and is motivated by measurable results.



Key Responsibilities

- Make outbound cold calls to business decision-makers.

- Introduce our clients' solutions and generate interest through consultative conversations.

- Qualify prospects by identifying business needs, challenges, and fit.

- Confidently handle objections and keep conversations moving toward the next step.

- Schedule qualified meetings for client Account Executives and sales teams.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, call notes, and activity tracking.

- Send follow-up
s or messages to improve meeting attendance and engagement.

- Follow established sales processes, call frameworks, and campaign guidelines.

- Collaborate with managers and teammates to improve campaign performance.

- Share feedback from prospect conversations to help refine messaging, scripts, and outreach strategies.



What We're Looking For

- Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, business development, sales development (SDR/BDR), telesales, inside sales, or another outbound sales role.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Comfortable speaking with executives, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

- Strong objection-handling and relationship-building abilities.

- Proven ability to meet or exceed activity, calling, or appointment-setting goals.

- Self-motivated, organized, and accountable while working remotely.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate CRM records.

- Experience with HubSpot, Nooks, Slack, Calendly, Coda, or similar sales tools is a plus.



What We Offer

title: Medical Billing Specialist
description:
Medical Billing Specialist

Full-Time | Remote | Healthcare



Please submit an up-to-date resume. Inquiries will not be considered without a resume.



Seeking an experienced Medical Billing Specialist to support U.S.-based healthcare practices on a full-time remote basis. This is a billing-first role built for professionals who know the full revenue cycle, not just one piece of it, and who take ownership of the financial health of the practices they support.



In this role, you will manage the complete billing cycle: claim submission, payment posting, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, and reporting. You will work directly with practice leadership and administrative teams to ensure claims are clean, payments are collected, and outstanding balances are resolved in a timely manner. You may also provide light support to front desk and administrative functions as a secondary responsibility.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Claims Submission & Billing Operations

- Process and submit insurance claims accurately and in a timely manner via EMR and clearinghouse systems

- Manage the full billing cycle including claim creation, submission, tracking, and follow-up

- Handle primary and secondary insurance claims, including out-of-network and manual tracking requirements

- Ensure all claims are submitted with correct coding, documentation, and payer-specific requirements

- Resolve billing discrepancies by identifying root causes, correcting errors, and rebilling claims as needed

- Ensure compliance with billing and coding regulations and maintain clean documentation for audit readiness



Accounts Receivable & Payment Management

- Monitor and reconcile the accounts receivable ledger and maintain accurate, up-to-date A/R records

- Follow up on outstanding balances, unpaid claims, and overdue accounts to support healthy cash flow

- Post insurance and patient payments to accounts accurately and ensure proper allocation

- Post zero-balance EOBs and process patient refunds as required

- Generate and distribute monthly statements to patients and clients

- Support collections workflows and escalate unresolved balances as appropriate

- Generate billing and A/R reports for practice leadership on a regular basis



Denials Management & Appeals

- Review denied claims promptly, research denial reasons, and determine the appropriate course of action

- Prepare and submit appeals with supporting documentation to secure proper reimbursement

- Track denial trends and communicate findings to leadership to support process improvements

- Follow up on appealed claims and rework as needed until resolution

- Identify and help prevent future denials through accurate claim preparation and payer knowledge



Patient Billing Communication

- Make outbound calls to patients or guarantors to follow up on outstanding balances, declined payments, or billing questions

- Communicate billing details, payment options, and insurance responsibilities clearly and professionally

- Respond to patient inquiries related to statements, claims, and account balances via phone and

- Document all billing-related communications and update patient records accordingly



Administrative & Reporting Support

- Maintain accurate electronic patient records and billing documentation within the EMR

- Track referrals, plans of care, and authorization-related billing requirements as needed

- Generate key performance and billing reports for management review

- Support insurance verification and benefits checks as needed to ensure billing accuracy

- Assist with administrative workflows, front desk backup duties, or special projects as assigned by the client

- Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

- 2+ years of hands-on medical billing experience: this is not an entry-level role

- Proven experience managing the full revenue cycle: claim submission, payment posting, A/R follow-up, and denials

- Strong working knowledge of insurance billing processes, payer requirements, and reimbursement rules

- Experience with denials management, including researching, correcting, appealing, and tracking claims to resolution

- Solid understanding of EOB interpretation, payment reconciliation, and accounts receivable principles

- Ability to handle both primary and secondary insurance claims, including manual follow-up processes

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: clear phone communication with patients and payers is essential

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through across all billing activities

- Ability to work independently, self-direct daily tasks, and meet targets without close supervision

- Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant remote work



Preferred

- Experience in an outpatient healthcare setting: physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or similar specialties

- Familiarity with common healthcare EMR and billing platforms (e.g., Prompt, WebPT, Raintree, or similar)

- Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, workers' compensation, and out-of-network billing

- Background working with multi-provider or high-volume clinic environments

- Comfort with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office (Word/Excel), and cloud-based communication tools



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Ownership: you treat the practice's A/R like your own and don't let claims sit unresolved

- Expertise: you can read an EOB, identify why a claim was denied, and know exactly what to do next

- Initiative: when something is off, you flag it, fix it, and help prevent it from happening again

- Reliability: your client team counts on your daily output; you show up, you deliver, and you communicate clearly

- Professionalism: you handle patient billing calls with patience, empathy, and accuracy



BENEFITS

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience

- Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth

- Work within a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive team environment

- Stable, full-time remote employment with U.S.-based healthcare clients

- Make a meaningful impact by helping practices serve their patients and communities

description:
# Short-Term Rental Operations Manager – Airbnb / Hospitable / PriceLabs



**Part-Time | Remote | Philippines**



I own a **13-unit furnished short-term rental property in Tacoma, Washington** and am looking for an experienced Short-Term Rental Operations Manager to help me transition from traditional property management to a streamlined, technology-driven operation.



**This is NOT an entry-level VA position.**



I am specifically looking for someone who already understands short-term rentals and has hands-on experience with Airbnb and STR management systems.



All 13 units are located in **one building**, and we already have an established local cleaning team and maintenance resources.



## Systems We Use / Will Use



Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



* Airbnb

* 

* Hospitable

* Hospitable Direct Booking

* PriceLabs

* Turno

* Smart locks

* STR monitoring/automation technology

You will help oversee the day-to-day operation while using automation wherever possible.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor guest communications and handle situations requiring human attention

* Monitor arrivals and departures

* Coordinate cleaners and turnovers

* Coordinate local maintenance when necessary

* Manage Hospitable automations

* Monitor Airbnb and 
 reservations

* Monitor PriceLabs pricing and occupancy

* Handle guest complaints and disputes

* Document and process guest damage claims

* Manage Airbnb AirCover reimbursement claims

* Process smoking/vaping violation documentation and reimbursement requests

* Enforce our late-checkout policy

* Make sure cleaners photograph damage BEFORE cleaning or repairs occur

* Maintain a Do-Not-Rent list for serious problem guests

* Assist with review disputes when appropriate

* Provide a short weekly operations report to the owner



## Direct Booking Growth



An important part of this position will be helping us **reduce our dependence on Airbnb and 
 over time.**



I want someone who can help:



* Set up and manage our **Hospitable Direct Booking website**

* Develop repeat-guest business where permitted

* Manage direct-booking inquiries

* Track direct-booking performance

* Develop 30–90 day furnished stays

* Help pursue corporate and mid-term housing opportunities



Potential mid-term customers include traveling medical professionals, corporate travelers, military personnel, contractors and insurance-displacement housing.



## What I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



* At least 2 years of STR/property-management experience

* Experience managing multiple STR units simultaneously

* Strong Airbnb experience

* Strong Hospitable experience

* PriceLabs experience

* Airbnb AirCover/damage claim experience

* Cleaner and maintenance coordination experience

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Ability to work independently without asking the owner about every routine decision



**
, Turno, Hospitable Direct Booking and mid-term rental experience are major advantages.**



Former Airbnb support employees are also strongly encouraged to apply.



## Hours



I expect this position to begin at approximately **15–20 hours per week**.



Much of the repetitive work will be automated through Hospitable, PriceLabs and our other systems. I am looking for someone to **manage the operation and exceptions**, not manually perform tasks that software can automate.



There is an opportunity for the role and hours to grow if justified by the property's needs and performance.



## To Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years have you worked in short-term rentals?

2. What is the largest number of STR units you have personally managed?

3. Describe your experience with Hospitable.

4. Have you used Hospitable Direct Booking?

5. Describe your PriceLabs experience.

6. How many Airbnb AirCover/damage claims have you handled?

7. Have you managed 
 properties?

8. Have you used Turno?

9. Have you coordinated cleaners and maintenance remotely?

10. Have you worked with smoking/noise monitoring systems such as Minut or Alertify?

11. Have you helped generate direct or repeat bookings?

12. What hours can you provide coverage in **U.S. Pacific Time**?

14. What hourly or monthly compensation are you requesting?



### Scenario Question



A cleaner enters a unit immediately after checkout. She smells marijuana, finds evidence that someone smoked inside, and notices that the guest also damaged the bed. Another guest is scheduled to check in later that afternoon.

StoryGen (storygen.agency) is a fast-growing B2B lead generation agency that builds and manages outbound sales teams for our clients. Our clients range from innovative tech startups to established service providers across industries such as SaaS, digital marketing, IT services, financial technology, staffing and recruitment, and business consulting.



About the Role

Behind every successful outbound campaign is a high-quality contact list, and that’s where you come in.



As our List Building Specialist, you’ll be responsible for researching, validating, and maintaining prospect lists that fuel our outbound campaigns. This isn’t a basic data-entry job. We’re looking for someone technical, detail-oriented, and AI-savvy, someone who can combine deep research with automation and AI tools to deliver accurate, scalable data.



You’ll manage enrichment workflows, set up API integrations in Clay, and ensure finalized lists are ready for our BDRs. Your work directly impacts campaign performance and client success.



Key Responsibilities

What We’re Looking For

- At least 1 year of experience in list building, lead research, or data enrichment (B2B sales/lead gen experience preferred).

- Strong technical ability — able to set up API integrations and troubleshoot workflows in tools like Clay.

- Highly interested with AI tools and eager to adopt new AI-driven workflows.

- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar tools.

- Proficiency in managing and maintaining databases in Supabase and HubSpot.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets, Excel).

- Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

- Quick learner, independent, and resourceful — able to deliver without heavy oversight.

- Previous experience with enrichment tools (Forager, Prospeo, ContactOut, IcyPeas) is highly preferred.



Compensation & Benefits

- USD 1,000 to 1,200 starting monthly compensation depending on proven experience.

- Accelerated opportunities for pay increase once you’ve mastered the entire process and can function independently.

title: Architectural Designer
description:
A boutique United States architecture firm specializing in high end custom homes, commercial development, adaptive reuse, and interior projects is seeking an experienced Architectural Designer based in the Philippines.

The firm’s approach emphasizes thoughtful design, contextual sensitivity, material quality, sustainability, and the careful integration of design with construction.

The company’s identity and project information will be disclosed to qualified candidates during the interview process.



Position Summary

The Architectural Designer will work remotely with the Principal Architect and project consultants to develop design concepts, prepare architectural drawings, produce construction documents, coordinate project information, and support projects from initial design through construction.

This position requires more than software proficiency. The successful candidate must understand architectural documentation, recognize coordination issues, follow design direction accurately, manage deadlines, and communicate proactively. Candidates must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment without requiring constant supervision.



Primary Responsibilities

Develop architectural plans, elevations, sections, details, diagrams, and presentation materials.

Prepare drawing sets for schematic design, design development, permit submission, bidding, and construction.

Translate sketches, markups, reference materials, and verbal direction from the Principal Architect into accurate architectural documents.

Create three dimensional models, renderings, material studies, and client presentation materials.

Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and constructability before submission.

Research applicable building codes, zoning requirements, planning restrictions, materials, products, and construction methods.

Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior design, landscape, and other consultant documents.

Identify drawing conflicts, missing information, and potential construction issues before they affect a project.

Revise documents based on internal reviews, consultant coordination, agency comments, and construction related questions.

Assist with finish selections, material schedules, door and window schedules, product research, and specification information.

Prepare existing condition drawings from photographs, field measurements, surveys, and reference documents.

Support construction administration by organizing submittals, requests for information, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and project records.

Maintain organized digital project files, drawing standards, model standards, and document naming conventions.

Track assigned tasks and deadlines and provide regular progress updates.

Communicate immediately when instructions are unclear, information is missing, or a deadline may be affected.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.

At least three years of professional experience with an architectural firm or design practice.

Experience preparing architectural drawings and coordinated construction document sets.

Strong understanding of architectural design, detailing, materials, dimensions, and building systems.

Ability to read and coordinate architectural, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Cloud, or closely comparable architectural software.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.

Ability to interpret sketches, redlines, design direction, and technical comments accurately.

Ability to manage multiple assignments without losing track of revisions, deadlines, or unresolved questions.

Reliable computer equipment and a stable, high speed internet connection suitable for large architectural files and remote meetings.

Availability during the agreed working schedule aligned with Pacific Time.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high end residential, hospitality, commercial interior, adaptive reuse, or tenant improvement projects.

Experience working remotely with United States architecture, engineering, or construction firms.

Familiarity with United States building codes, zoning requirements, permitting processes, and architectural drawing standards.

Experience coordinating directly with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and other consultants.

Experience with visualization, rendering, and presentation software.

Familiarity with sustainable design principles and modern building technologies.

Experience supporting projects during permitting and construction.

Familiarity with Bluebeam Revu and cloud based project collaboration platforms.



Professional Expectations

The selected contractor must demonstrate accountability, initiative, accuracy, and consistent follow through.

This role requires someone who can recognize problems instead of simply completing assigned drafting. The contractor must ask informed questions, confirm priorities, maintain organized documentation, and communicate progress without waiting to be contacted.

All project drawings, designs, models, documents, client information, and company information must be treated as confidential. All work produced under this engagement will remain the property of the company.



Application Requirements

Please submit the following:

Current resume

Architectural portfolio

Samples of construction documents or technical drawings

Brief explanation of your specific contribution to each portfolio project

List of software programs and proficiency level

Current location in the Philippines

Available working hours in Pacific Time

Internet speed and computer specifications

Expected monthly contractor rate in Philippine pesos

Candidates whose portfolios only contain academic projects, renderings, or work without a clear explanation of their responsibilities may not be considered.

title: Senior Google Ads, LSA & Paid Social Specialist | Lead Generation
description:
Google Ads, LSA & Paid Social



Google Ads will be the primary focus of this position, and we're looking for someone with deep, hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid search campaigns.



You'll also be involved in managing **Google Local Services Ads (LSA)** accounts for our clients, including:



* Monitoring LSA performance, lead volume and lead quality

* Reviewing leads and disputing eligible invalid leads when applicable

* Monitoring budgets, bidding and account spend

* Reviewing service categories, job types and service areas

* Monitoring profile and account health

* Troubleshooting performance, verification and eligibility issues

* Identifying opportunities to improve lead volume, lead quality and cost per qualified lead



Meta Ads



We also manage paid social campaigns through **Meta Ads**, and we're looking for someone who has at least some hands-on experience with the platform and is **excited to become significantly more advanced in it.**



You don't need to be a Meta Ads expert on day one. You should, however, understand the fundamentals and be comfortable working inside Meta Ads Manager.



Experience with the following is a plus:



* Meta Ads Manager

* Campaign, ad set and ad structure

* Lead generation campaigns

* Website conversion campaigns

* Remarketing and custom audiences

* Creative and messaging testing

* Meta Pixel and conversion tracking

* Budget and performance optimization

* Analyzing lead quality—not simply cost per lead



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop deep expertise in Meta Ads and is willing to actively learn, test and improve.



Our ideal candidate is already an excellent Google Ads specialist who wants to become an exceptional **cross-channel paid media strategist.**



What We're Looking For



Ideally, you have:



* **4+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience**

* Advanced knowledge of Google Search

* Strong experience with lead-generation campaigns

* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Agency experience

* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets

* Experience with Performance Max, Display, YouTube and remarketing

* Experience managing Google Local Services Ads

* **Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and a strong desire to become highly proficient with the platform**

* Strong understanding of automated bidding strategies—and when you should or shouldn't use them

* Experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong written English communication

* The ability to work independently while collaborating with a team

* A willingness to raise your hand when something doesn't look right



Experience working with **contractors, home services or other local lead-generation businesses in the United States** is a major plus.



Google Ads certifications and Meta certifications are helpful, but we're far more interested in your real-world experience and how you think.



Interested?



We'd love to learn a little more about you.



To apply, please send us:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your Google Ads experience.



2. How many years you've personally managed Google Ads accounts hands-on.



3. The approximate largest **monthly Google Ads budget** you've personally been responsible for managing.



4. Briefly describe your experience with **Google Local Services Ads (LSA)**, including approximately how many accounts you've managed and what your responsibilities included.



5. Briefly describe your experience with **Meta Ads**. What types of campaigns have you personally managed, and what would you most like to become better at?



6. In 3–5 sentences, tell us about **one Google Ads optimization or common "best practice" that you frequently disagree with—and why.**

8. Your desired monthly compensation.



Please include the word Analytics somewhere in the title/subject line of your application.



We're not looking for lengthy answers or perfectly polished applications. We're looking for experienced people who understand paid media, communicate clearly, pay attention to details, and are excited about continuing to develop their skills.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Build and Lead the Marketing & Sales Team for a Luxury Nature Resort



Backland is a luxury nature resort located on 160 private acres surrounded by the Kaibab National Forest in Northern Arizona, near the Grand Canyon.



We are looking for an exceptional Marketing Director / Head of Marketing to take ownership of our marketing operation and build and manage a talented remote marketing team.



This is not a position for someone who simply waits for the owner to assign marketing tasks.



We are looking for someone who can take a business objective such as:



“We need to increase weekday occupancy among couples this fall.”



…and turn it into a coordinated plan across paid advertising,
, content, direct sales, and our website — determine what needs to be done, assign the right people, make sure the work gets completed well, measure the results, and improve from what we learn.



Your Mission



Your job is simple to describe:



Build and lead a marketing organization that consistently generates profitable bookings for Backland.



You will report directly to the owner and be responsible for turning high-level company goals into marketing strategy and execution.



An important part of this role will be helping us determine the right structure for the marketing department.



We already know there are several important capabilities we need to cover, including:



, CRM, and lifecycle marketing

Reservation and phone sales

Paid advertising and growth marketing

Content creation and social media

Website conversion and marketing technology

Marketing analytics and reporting



Some of these functions may require dedicated specialists. Others may be combined into broader roles. Some may be handled internally while others are better outsourced.



We are not committed to a specific number of employees.



We want our Marketing Director to help us build the smallest, strongest team capable of executing our marketing strategy exceptionally well.



What You Will Own

1. Marketing Strategy & Planning



Work directly with the owner to understand:



Revenue goals

Occupancy needs

Target guest segments

Seasonality

Promotions and offers

Brand positioning

New experiences and products

Business priorities



Then turn those goals into an actionable marketing plan.



You will:



Develop quarterly, monthly, and campaign-level marketing plans.

Maintain a coordinated marketing calendar.

Determine which marketing channels should support each initiative.

Establish priorities based on business impact.

Create campaign briefs and assign work.

Establish deadlines and make sure projects ship.

Identify new opportunities.

Continually evaluate what we should do more of, less of, start doing, or stop doing.



We do not need someone who simply gives us more marketing ideas.



We need someone who turns good ideas into results.



2. Build the Marketing Team



One of your first responsibilities will be evaluating our existing resources and helping determine the best structure for the marketing department.



You will help answer questions such as:



Which marketing functions require dedicated specialists?

Which responsibilities can reasonably be combined?

Which roles should be full-time versus part-time?

Which activities should stay in-house?

Which activities would be better handled by outside specialists?

Where are our largest current capability gaps?

In what order should we hire?



You will then help recruit and build the team.



This may include hiring and managing people responsible for areas such as:



 / CRM / Lifecycle Marketing



We need someone to take genuine ownership of our
 and CRM program, including:



Prospect nurture

Abandoned-booking campaigns

Promotional
s

Newsletters

Segmentation

Automated lifecycle flows

Reservation communication

Pre-arrival campaigns

Upsells

Post-stay communication

Review and referral campaigns

Repeat-guest marketing

Win-back campaigns

Testing and optimization

Deliverability and database health



We currently use Cendyn for CRM and
 marketing.



Reservation & Phone Sales



We need excellent sales coverage for guests who are considering a Backland stay.



This function may include:



Answering inbound reservation calls.

Responding to reservation inquiries.

Calling back missed calls.

Following up with prospective guests.

Recovering promising abandoned bookings.

Overcoming objections.

Closing reservations.

Upselling additional nights, room upgrades, dining, packages, and experiences.

Maintaining lead information.

Tracking why prospective guests do or do not book.



This is not simply customer service.



The objective is to convert existing demand into revenue.



Paid Advertising / Growth Marketing



We need strong ownership of customer acquisition through channels such as:



Meta Ads

Google Ads

Retargeting

Metasearch

Audience testing

Creative testing

Budget optimization

Campaign optimization

Attribution

CPA and ROAS analysis

Landing-page testing



We want someone constantly asking:



Which campaigns are generating profitable bookings?

Which audiences are working?

Which creative is winning?

What is our true cost per booking?

Where is our funnel leaking?

Where should we increase or reduce spending?

What should we test next?

Content & Creative



Backland is an extremely visual product, so we need a strong content engine supporting the entire marketing organization.



This function may include:



Short-form video

Reels and social content

Paid-ad creative

 creative

Promotional graphics

Photo and video editing

Content repurposing

Organic social publishing

Maintaining and organizing our creative library

Coordinating UGC, photography, or outside creators when needed



Content should be created for a marketing purpose, not simply to keep a social media calendar full.



Our paid,
, sales, and website teams should be able to communicate what creative they need, and the content function should deliver it.



Website, Conversion & Marketing Technology



Depending on the team we build, some of this work may be handled internally or through outside technical specialists.



It includes:



Website and landing-page optimization

Booking-funnel conversion

Analytics implementation

Tracking and attribution

Marketing integrations

SEO

Conversion-rate optimization

Marketing technology

Testing website messaging and offers



You do not need to personally perform all of these functions.



You need to make sure they are covered by the right people.



3. Lead and Manage the Team



Once the team is in place, you will be responsible for making it effective.



Your responsibilities will include:



Recruiting and interviewing candidates.

Designing practical tests for potential hires.

Onboarding new team members.

Establishing clear responsibilities and ownership.

Setting KPIs.

Assigning projects and priorities.

Conducting regular meetings and one-on-ones.

Reviewing work and providing feedback.

Training and coaching employees.

Holding team members accountable.

Identifying performance problems early.

Helping strong employees grow.

Improving systems and processes over time.



Your goal is to create a department that operates effectively without the owner needing to personally manage each marketing employee.



4. Coordinate Marketing Across Channels



One of the most important parts of this position is making sure our marketing activities work together rather than operating as separate silos.



For example, imagine we d
:



“We need to increase Sunday–Thursday bookings from couples during October.”



The marketing response might involve:



Paid advertising targeting the right audience.

An
 campaign to relevant past guests and prospects.

New couples-focused creative.

A landing page or website changes supporting the offer.

Reservation sales following up personally with high-intent leads.

Reporting that tells us which elements actually produced bookings.



Your job is to make sure the entire campaign comes together.



5. Marketing Analytics & Accountability



We want a marketing department that is accountable for business results.



You will establish a clear marketing dashboard and regularly report on the metrics that matter.



Depending on the channel, these may include:



Direct booking revenue

Occupancy

Website conversion rate

Cost per booking

Customer acquisition cost

ROAS

-attributed revenue

 conversion

Lead-to-booking conversion

Reservation sales conversion

Upsell revenue

Campaign performance

Channel profitability



We are not interested in reports dominated by vanity metrics.



We want to know:



What worked?

What didn't?

Why?

What did we learn?

What are we doing next?



What Success Looks Like



Within six months, we want the owner to be able to say:



“I still help set the direction for Backland, but I no longer have to personally manage marketing execution.”



You should understand what is happening across every major marketing function.



Everyone working in marketing should know what they own.



Campaigns should launch without the owner repeatedly following up.



Good ideas should become completed projects.



Results should be measured.



Problems should be identified early.



Poor-performing activities should be changed or stopped.



Successful activities should be expanded.



And the marketing organization should continually become stronger.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



Have significant experience in digital marketing.

Have successfully managed marketers or remote employees.

Have recruited and built teams before.

Understand marketing funnels and customer journeys.

Understand paid customer acquisition.

Understand
 and CRM marketing.

Understand content and creative strategy.

Understand sales conversion.

Are highly organized.

Are comfortable making decisions.

Have excellent spoken and written English.

Communicate proactively.

Can manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Are analytical and comfortable working with numbers.

Can distinguish between marketing that looks impressive and marketing that produces revenue.

Give clear, constructive feedback.

Enjoy developing people.

Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

Can work independently.

Are willing to challenge an idea respectfully when you believe there is a better approach.



Hospitality, travel, luxury, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer experience would be especially valuable.



You Do NOT Need to Be the Best at Everything



We are not looking for someone who claims to personally be:



An elite media buyer

An expert
 marketer

A graphic designer

A professional video editor

A world-class copywriter

A web developer

An SEO expert

A reservation salesperson



That's why we are building a team.



We are looking for someone who understands these disciplines well enough to:



Identify what capabilities we need.

Hire the right specialists.

Give them clear direction.

Evaluate their work.

Coordinate their efforts.

Hold them accountable.

Measure the results.



Ideally, however, you should have at least one area of marketing in which you have deep hands-on expertise.



We want to know what that is.



Player-Coach Mentality



Backland's marketing department is still being built.



This is not yet a large corporate marketing organization where the Marketing Director spends all day attending meetings and reviewing presentations.



You should be willing to jump in when necessary.



That might mean:



Reviewing and improving an
.

Digging through campaign data.

Writing a campaign brief.

Helping an employee solve a problem.

Reviewing an ad.

Building a spreadsheet.

Researching a competitor.

Helping develop a sales process.

Fixing a project that has gotten off track.



Over time, as the organization grows, this position should become increasingly focused on leadership.



Right now, we need a player-coach who can build the team as well as lead it.



About Backland



Backland is a luxury nature resort located on a private 160-acre property surrounded by the Kaibab National Forest between Flagstaff and Williams, Arizona.



Our guests come to experience nature without sacrificing comfort.



Backland offers unique luxury accommodations, panoramic views, incredible dark skies, private hot tubs, an on-site restaurant, stargazing, kayaking, hiking, and convenient access to the Grand Canyon.



Learn more at 
.



How to Apply



Please do not send us a generic cover letter.



Instead, answer the following questions:



Tell us about the most significant marketing team or department you have managed. What functions were you responsible for?

Have you ever built or recruited a marketing team? What roles did you hire and how did you d
 what positions were needed?

What marketing discipline are you personally strongest in?

Tell us about one marketing campaign you were responsible for. What was the objective, what did you and your team do, and what measurable result did it produce?



Imagine you joined Backland and we told you:



“Our occupancy four months from now is weaker than we want it to be. We need more couples to book Sunday through Thursday stays.”



Briefly explain how you would approach the problem.



Imagine that Backland needs strong capabilities in
 marketing, reservation sales, paid advertising, and content creation. How would you d
 whether to hire four specialists, combine some of these responsibilities, use part-time employees, or outsource certain functions?

Tell us about a time someone reporting to you was not performing well. What did you do?

If you were hired, what would you want to understand and accomplish during your first 30 days?

What metrics would you want to see every week if you were responsible for Backland's marketing?

What hours are you normally available to work?



At the very end of your application, include the phrase:



ONE AMAZING TEAM



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.
